summary.en: Hong Kong's Commissioner for Labour, Sam Hui Chark-shum, has indicated openness to classifying heatstroke as an occupational disease. This consideration comes after modeling showed the city's revised heat warning system would have issued stronger alerts on two exceptionally hot days last month, suggesting a growing...
summary.zh: 香港劳工处处长许德成表示，当局愿意考虑将中暑列为职业病。此前模型显示，本港修订后的酷热警告系统在上月两个异常炎热的日子本应发出更强烈的警报，这表明人们日益认识到需要更好地保护工人免受极端高温的影响。

body.en: Hong Kong labour authorities are open to classifying heatstroke as an occupational disease, the city’s labour chief has said, acknowledging the revamped heat warning system would have triggered stronger alerts on two exceptionally hot days last month. Commissioner for Labour Sam Hui Chark-shum said retrospective modelling showed the revised system would have issued a black warning on August 8 and a red alert on August 9, when the Observatory recorded 36.9 degrees Celsius (98.4 Fahrenheit) at its...
body.zh: 香港劳工主管表示，香港劳工当局愿意将中暑列为职业病，并承认改进后的高温预警系统将在上个月的两个异常炎热的日子里引发更强烈的警报。劳工处处长许焯岑表示，回顾性模型显示，修订后的系统将在8月8日发出黑色警报，并在8月9日发出红色警报，当时天文台录得36.9摄氏度（98.4华氏度）的最高气温。

reflection.en: The news from Hong Kong signals a potential shift towards recognizing the physical toll of labor under extreme conditions. The willingness to classify heatstroke as an occupational disease reflects a growing understanding of employers' responsibility for worker well-being, echoing the call to 'do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your...
reflection.zh: 香港传来的消息预示着在承认极端天气下劳动的身体代价方面可能出现转变。将中暑列为职业病的意愿，反映了人们日益认识到雇主对工人福祉的责任，这呼应了“施行公义，喜爱怜悯，谦卑与你的神同行”的呼召。这一举措承认，工人的健康和安全，特别是那些暴露在恶劣环境中的工人，是一个公正社会不可或缺的一部分。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Fatal cycling accidents in Hong Kong more than double in first half of 2026
title.zh: 2026年上半年香港自行车事故死亡人数翻倍

summary.en: Fatal cycling accidents in Hong Kong more than doubled in the first half of 2026 compared to the previous year, resulting in nine deaths. Police attribute this surge to cyclists disregarding traffic signals and road signs. In total, 63 people died in 59 fatal traffic accidents during the first six months of the year,...
summary.zh: 2026年上半年，香港的致命自行车事故比去年同期增加了一倍多，造成九人死亡。警方指出，这是由于骑自行车者无视交通信号和路标所致。今年前六个月，共有63人在59起致命交通事故中丧生，比去年同期增加了40%以上。

body.en: Fatal cycling accidents in Hong Kong more than doubled in the first half of 2026 compared with a year earlier, with nine deaths recorded, as police point to cyclists ignoring traffic signals and road signs. Overall, there were 59 fatal traffic accidents in the first six months of the year, killing 63 people, up more than 40 per cent from a year earlier. Fatal cases involving bicycles surged 125 per cent, accounting for nine of those deaths. “Most cyclists tend to ignore traffic signals and road...
body.zh: 2026 年上半年，香港致命的自行车事故比一年前增加了一倍多，造成 9 人死亡，原因是骑自行车的人无视交通信号和路标。总体而言，今年前六个月共发生59起致命交通事故，造成63人死亡，比去年同期增加40%以上。涉及自行车的死亡案件激增 125%，其中 9 人死亡。 “大多数骑自行车的人往往会忽视交通信号和道路......

reflection.en: The alarming rise in fatal cycling accidents in Hong Kong, with nine lives lost in just six months, underscores a dangerous disregard for traffic laws. This pattern of ignoring signals and signs leads to tragic consequences, echoing the ancient wisdom that those who live by the sword, or in this case, by reckless disregard for order, will perish by it. May...
reflection.zh: 香港致命自行车事故的惊人增加，仅六个月就夺去了九条生命，这凸显了对交通法规的危险漠视。这种无视信号和标志的行为导致了悲惨的后果，呼应了古老的智慧——以刀剑（或在此情境下，以鲁莽地无视秩序）生活的人，必将因此灭亡。愿我们都牢记，我们在道路上的行为会对我们自己和他人产生深远的影响。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Call for employers to manage heat risks in workplace
title.zh: 呼吁雇主管理工作场所高温风险

summary.en: Commissioner for Labour Sam Hui urged employers on Sunday to familiarize themselves with the newly refined heat stress at work warning system. Hui stressed that employers have a legal responsibility to manage heat-related risks for their workers in extreme temperatures, noting that failure to do so is illegal.
summary.zh: 劳工处处长许涌明周日敦促雇主熟悉新修订的工作暑热警告系统。许处长强调，雇主有法律责任在极端高温下管理工人面临的热相关风险，并指出未能这样做是违法的。

body.en: Commissioner for Labour Sam Hui on Sunday urged employers to familiarise themselves with the newly refined heat stress at work warning system. Hui said many employers may not be familiar with the new framework and stressed they have a legal responsibility to manage heat-related risks for their workers in extreme temperatures. "The system is not a law in itself, but even if the guidelines are not issued, all employers are responsible for the burden of occupational health and safety encountered by workers. The risks includes heat exhaustion and heatstroke," he said on a TVB programme. "If an employer does not take responsibility of risk management in this regard, it is actually illegal under the Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance." His remarks came as authorities added two new triggers to the system at the end of August. Hui said construction sites and other employers should not interpret heat warnings as automatic orders to halt all work. Instead, Hui added, they should conduct advance risk assessments, introduce cooling stations, fans, ventilation, shade and cooling clothing, and reschedule heavy labour away from the hottest hours. In response to whether the system should adopt the international Wet-bulb Globe Temperature standard, Hui said it would not fully address Hong Kong’s humid, poorly ventilated working environments, including indoor workplaces without air conditioning. He added the government would evaluate data from the summer before making any further adjustments to the system ahead of the next hot season. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 劳工处处长许冠杰周日敦促雇主熟悉新完善的工作热应激预警系统。许说，许多雇主可能不熟悉新框架，并强调他们有法律责任在极端温度下管理工人与高温相关的风险。他在TVB节目中表示：“该制度本身并不是法律，但即使没有发布指引，所有雇主也要对工人所遇到的职业健康和安全负担负责。风险包括中暑和中暑。” “如果雇主不承担这方面的风险管理责任，根据《职业安全健康条例》，实际上是违法的。”他发表此番言论之际，当局于八月底在该系统中添加了两个新的触发器。许说，建筑工地和其他雇主不应将高温警告解读为自动停止所有工作的命令。许补充说，相反，他们应该进行预先的风险评估，引入冷却站、风扇、通风、遮阳和降温服装，并重新安排繁重的劳动，远离最热的时间。在回应该系统是否应采用国际湿球温度标准时，许表示，该系统并不能完全解决香港潮湿、通风不良的工作环境，包括没有空调的室内工作场所。他补充说，政府将评估夏季的数据，然后在下一个炎热季节之前对系统进行进一步调整。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: As temperatures rise, the call for employers to protect their workers from heat-related illness highlights a fundamental aspect of justice. This echoes the prophet Micah's timeless instruction: to act justly, love mercy, and walk humbly with Yahweh. True leadership involves diligent care for those whose well-being depends on our responsible actions.
reflection.zh: 随着气温升高，呼吁雇主保护工人免受高温相关疾病的侵害，凸显了公正的一个基本方面。这呼应了先知弥迦永恒的教导：行公义，好怜悯，谦卑地与雅伟同行。真正的领导力在于勤勉地关怀那些福祉依赖于我们负责任行为的人。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: 5-yr plan, Policy Address to improve livelihoods: CE
title.zh: 五年规划、施政报告旨在改善民生：行政长官

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee announced on Sunday that Hong Kong's first five-year plan will focus on improving people's livelihoods through long-term strategies. The plan, along with the upcoming Policy Address, aims to provide concrete measures for enhancing living conditions, following extensive public consultation.
summary.zh: 行政长官李家超周日表示，香港首个五年规划将通过制定长远策略来改善民生。李家超在社交媒体发布的视频中说，当局在过去两个月内就该蓝图和最新的施政报告收集了公众意见。他表示，同一天发布这两份文件旨在方便公众理解两者之间的互补关系。“香港首个五年规划将通过长远发展策略持续改善民生，而施政报告将每年制定具体措施来改善住房。”

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee on Sunday said Hong Kong’s first five-year plan would improve people’s livelihoods with the formulation of long-term strategies for the city. In a video posted on his social media, Lee said authorities had been collecting public opinions towards the blueprint and the latest Policy Address over the past two months. He said delivering the two documents on the same day aims to facilitate the public’s understanding of the complementary relationship between the two items. “Hong Kong’s first five-year plan will enhance people’s livelihoods continuously through long-term development strategies, while the Policy Address will set out concrete measures each year to improve housing, people’s livelihoods, healthcare and other areas,” he said. “I thank people for their valuable suggestions for the first five-year plan and the latest Policy Address during the public consultation period. “We will review and incorporate these views in the documents to drive economic development, improve people’s livelihoods and create new opportunities for Hong Kong.” Lee went on to say that the SAR government would continue to focus on people’s needs and drive Hong Kong forward. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周日表示，香港第一个五年计划将通过制定香港的长期战略来改善民生。李在其社交媒体上发布的一段视频中表示，过去两个月，当局一直在收集公众对蓝图和最新施政报告的意见。他表示，同一天递交这两份文件，是为了让公众了解两者之间的互补关系。他说：“香港第一个五年规划将通过长远发展策略不断改善民生，而施政报告每年都会提出改善住房、民生、医疗等领域的具体措施。” “感谢大家在公众咨询期间对第一个五年规划和最新施政报告提出的宝贵意见。我们会检讨这些意见，并将其纳入文件中，以推动经济发展、改善民生，为香港创造新机遇。”李肇星表示，特区政府将继续以民为本，推动香港向前发展。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The Chief Executive has outlined a vision for Hong Kong's future, emphasizing long-term strategies to enhance the well-being of its citizens. This focus on improving livelihoods echoes the ancient prophetic call for leaders to govern justly and ensure the welfare of the people they serve. May this plan bring tangible improvements and reflect a commitment to...
reflection.zh: 行政长官勾勒了香港未来的愿景，强调通过长远策略来提升市民福祉。这种对改善民生的关注，呼应了古代先知对领袖的呼召，要公正地治理，并确保他们所服务的人民的福祉。愿这项计划带来切实的改善，并体现治理上的公义承诺。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Calls for Hong Kong anti-stalking law after man acquitted of following teen girl
title.zh: 呼吁香港制定反跟踪法，此前一名男子被判无罪

summary.en: Lawmakers and a government adviser are calling for anti-stalking legislation in Hong Kong to address a legal gap that hinders the prosecution of persistent harassment. This comes after a man was acquitted of loitering charges, with the magistrate noting the absence of specific laws against stalking.
summary.zh: 在一名男子被控游荡罪名后获判无罪，并且裁判官指出缺乏禁止跟踪的法律之后，香港的立法者和政府顾问呼吁制定反跟踪法，以解决阻碍起诉持续骚扰行为的法律漏洞。

body.en: Lawmakers and a government adviser have called for anti-stalking legislation to close a loophole that makes prosecuting repeated harassment difficult in Hong Kong, following the acquittal of a man who followed a teenage girl to her secondary school classroom. Some experts said the government should revisit a proposal for such legislation raised 26 years ago, after the magistrate who acquitted the defendant of a loitering charge also noted the absence of laws to criminalise stalking under certain...
body.zh: 一名跟踪十几岁女孩进入中学教室的男子被无罪释放后，立法者和一名政府顾问呼吁制定反跟踪立法，以堵住香港因多次骚扰而难以起诉的漏洞。一些专家表示，政府应该重新审视 26 年前提出的此类立法提案，此前宣判被告游荡指控无罪的治安法官还指出，在某些情况下，缺乏将跟踪行为定为刑事犯罪的法律。

reflection.en: The acquittal of a man accused of following a teenage girl to her classroom in Hong Kong underscores a concerning gap in legal protections. It raises the question of how society ensures the safety and dignity of its most vulnerable, particularly young people, when existing laws fall short. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for...
reflection.zh: 一名男子在香港被指控跟踪一名女学生至教室后获判无罪，这凸显了法律保护方面令人担忧的漏洞。当现有法律不足以保护弱势群体时，它提出了社会如何确保其最脆弱群体，特别是年轻人的安全和尊严的问题。箴言31:8-9呼吁我们“为不能说话的人说话，为所有贫困者的权利说话。”这种情况要求我们重新致力于倡导和保护那些可能被轻易忽视或伤害的人。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: HK, Fujian share close ties: CY Leung
title.zh: 梁振英：香港与福建关系密切

summary.en: CY Leung, Vice-chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, lauded the strong relationship between Hong Kong and Fujian province. He noted that individuals of Fujian origin constitute about one-sixth of Hong Kong's population and hold significant influence across various sectors. Leung also...
summary.zh: 全国政协副主席梁振英赞扬了香港与福建省之间的紧密联系。他指出，祖籍福建的香港居民约占香港总人口的六分之一，并在该市各行各业中具有重要影响力。梁振英还强调，香港一直是福建最大的外商投资来源地和离岸融资中心，并拥有广泛的国际贸易网络以及专业的全球贸易和物流服务。

body.en: Vice-chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, CY Leung, on Sunday praised Hong Kong's close ties with Fujian province. Speaking at a forum looking at ways in which the two places collaborate, Leung said Hong Kong residents of Fujian origin account for about one-sixth of the SAR’s total population and they have significant influence across different sectors in the city. “Hong Kong has long been Fujian’s largest source of foreign investment and an offshore financing hub,” he said. “It has an extensive international trade network, as well as professional global trade and logistics services. “Hong Kong goes global, wins global, buys global and sells global. It is the preferred super-connector for Fujian’s going-global and bringing-in efforts.” Leung also said Hong Kong and Fujian had signed 28 agreements in 11 sectors including aviation, innovation and dispute resolution in June, offering a solid foundation for further cooperation. Guo Ningning, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Fujian Provincial Committee, said Hong Kong serves as an international financial, shipping, trade and innovation centre. It is of great significance to deepen cooperation between Hong Kong and Fujian under the 15th Five-Year Plan period, she added. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 中国人民政治协商会议副主席梁振英周日赞扬香港与福建省的密切关系。梁振英在探讨两地合作的论坛上表示，福建裔香港居民约占特区总人口的六分之一，他们在香港不同界别都有着重要影响力。 “香港长期以来是福建省最大的外资来源地和离岸融资中心，”他说。 “它拥有广泛的国际贸易网络，以及专业的全球贸易和物流服务。”“香港走向全球、赢全球、买全球、卖全球。”是福建走出去、引进来的首选超级联系人。”梁振英还表示，今年6月，香港与福建在航空、创新、争议解决等11个领域签署了28项协议，为进一步合作奠定了坚实的基础。福建省委副书记郭宁宁表示，香港是国际金融、航运、贸易和创新中心。她表示，“十五五”时期深化香港与福建合作具有重要意义。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The story highlights the deep-rooted connections and mutual contributions between Hong Kong and Fujian, particularly through the significant presence and influence of Fujian natives in Hong Kong. This collaboration underscores the importance of civic responsibility and the positive impact individuals can have when they contribute to the well-being of their...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻强调了香港与福建之间深厚的联系和相互贡献，特别是通过祖籍福建的居民在香港的重要存在和影响力。这种合作凸显了公民责任的重要性，以及当个人为社区和经济领域做出贡献时所能产生的积极影响。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Chinese guitar capital’s stairway to export heaven
title.zh: 中国吉他之都的出口天堂之路

summary.en: The town of Zheng'an in China's Guizhou province has become a global center for guitar manufacturing, producing one in seven of the world's guitars. A decade ago, the industry did not exist, but now giant guitar sculptures and murals signify its dominance in the local landscape.
summary.zh: 中国贵州省的郑安县已成为全球吉他制造中心，生产了全球七分之一的吉他。十年前，这里还没有这个产业，但如今巨大的吉他雕塑和壁画标志着它在当地景观中的主导地位。

body.en: It doesn’t take long to guess the main industry of the Chinese town of Zheng’an. A giant guitar sculpture dominates the central square, guitar murals adorn walls and pavements and even the rubbish bins are shaped like guitars. This photo taken on July 27, 2026 shows a worker making a guitar at a guitar workshop in Zheng’an, in southwestern China’s Guizhou Province. Photo: Jade Gao/AFP. This corner of the southwest province of Guizhou produces one in every seven of the instruments sold worldwide. A decade ago, it had no guitar-making industry to speak of at all. There are hundreds of specialised manufacturing towns in China, producing items ranging from bicycles to socks. But the speed and scale of Zheng’an’s rise make it an example of the impact of China’s industrial strategy when a combination of local and central government investment is deployed to maximise favourable local conditions. For years, the town’s working-age residents left to find employment in factories in Guangdong, southern China’s manufacturing hub. Among them was Zheng Chuanjiu, who eventually started his own guitar-making business in the provincial capital Guangzhou. “The company was doing pretty well at that time and most of our staff in Guangzhou were also our fellow villagers from Zheng’an,” the founder of Shenqu Guitar told AFP. Embed from Getty Images In 2012, Zheng’an local authorities rolled out an initiative called “return the phoenix to the nest”, to encourage skilled migrant workers to return home and start businesses. “The county officials reached out to us. They wanted us to come back and develop the industry,” Zheng said. Shenqu became the first guitar manufacturer to settle in Zheng’an’s new economic zone. “After I’d been working here for a few years, many friends saw how well I was doing and came here to join me to develop the industry,” he said. When AFP visited Shenqu in July, rows upon rows of finished guitars sat neatly on racks, awaiting final tuning checks before shipment. “Why go far away to work when home is the best place?” a banner in the factory read. Natural advantages Within around 10 years, 87 home‑grown brands had emerged from the industrial cluster. Embed from Getty Images Authorities enticed companies with comprehensive financial, tax and employment support packages — some were offered three‑year tax exemptions and 10 years of free rent. Importantly though, Zheng’an has natural advantages in its favour. The area’s climate is perfect for guitar-making, according to master luthier Zhang Weiyi, who relocated his business from Guangzhou in 2019. “Whether the industry is big or small,...
body.zh: 不用多久就可以猜出中国正安小镇的主要产业。中央广场上矗立着巨大的吉他雕塑，墙壁和人行道上装饰着吉他壁画，甚至垃圾桶的形状也像吉他。这张照片拍摄于 2026 年 7 月 27 日，中国西南部贵州省正安市的一个吉他作坊里，一名工人正在制作吉他。照片：Jade Gau/法新社。全球销售的乐器中，七分之一的乐器都产自贵州省西南部的这个角落。十年前，它根本没有吉他制造行业可言。中国有数百个专业制造城镇，生产从自行车到袜子等各种产品。但正安崛起的速度和规模使其成为中国产业战略影响的一个例子，该战略将地方和中央政府投资结合起来，最大限度地发挥当地的有利条件。多年来，该镇的劳动年龄居民纷纷离开，前往中国南方制造业中心广东的工厂寻找工作。其中包括郑传九，他最终在省会广州开始了自己的吉他制作业务。神曲吉他创始人告诉法新社：“当时公司经营得很好，我们在广州的大部分员工也是正安的老乡。” 2012年，正安当地政府推出了一项名为“凤凰还巢”的举措，鼓励熟练农民工返乡创业。 “县政府官员联系了我们。他们希望我们回来发展这个行业，”郑说。神曲成为第一家落户正安新经济区的吉他制造商。 “我在这里工作几年后，很多朋友看到我做得很好，就来这里和我一起发展这个行业，”他说。法新社7月访问神曲时，一排排成品吉他整齐地摆放在架子上，等待装运前的最后调音检查。 “既然家是最好的地方，为什么还要去很远的地方工作呢？”工厂里的横幅上写着。天然优势 近10年间，产业集群涌现出87个本土品牌。当局以全面的财务、税收和就业支持计划来吸引企业——其中一些企业获得了三年免税和十年免租的优惠。但重要的是，正安有着天然的优势。该地区的气候非常适合吉他制作，制琴大师张伟一于 2019 年将自己的生意从广州搬迁到这里。“无论这个行业是大还是小，...

reflection.en: The town of Zheng'an has transformed itself into a global hub for guitar production, a testament to focused effort and skilled craftsmanship. This dedication to producing quality instruments, from a town with no prior industry, echoes the biblical call to 'whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.' It's a...
reflection.zh: 郑安县已将自己转变为全球吉他生产中心，这证明了专注的努力和熟练的工艺。这个曾经没有任何产业的城镇，如今致力于生产高质量的乐器，这呼应了圣经的呼召：“无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是为主做的，不像为人做的。” 它提醒我们，在日常工作中勤奋和卓越可以荣耀神。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Students in SARs set for live lecture from space
title.zh: 香港学生将有机会收看太空直播讲座

summary.en: Students and teachers in Hong Kong and Macao will soon have the opportunity to watch live scientific experiments from the three Shenzhou-23 astronauts currently aboard the Tiangong Space Station, including Hong Kong's first astronaut Lai Ka-ying. This "Tiangong Class" activity is described as a valuable aerospace...
summary.zh: 香港和澳门的学生及教师将很快有机会观看目前在天宫空间站的三名神舟23号宇航员进行的现场科学实验直播，其中包括香港首位宇航员赖嘉颖。此次“天宫课堂”活动被描述为一项宝贵的太空科学教育活动。

body.en: Students and teachers in Hong Kong and Macao will soon have the opportunity to watch live scientific experiments from the three Shenzhou-23 astronauts currently aboard the Tiangong Space Station, including Hong Kong's first astronaut Lai Ka-ying. In an announcement on Saturday, an HKSAR government spokesman said the "Tiangong Class" Hong Kong and Macao Designated Session will be a valuable aerospace science education activity for students conducted in the unique environment of space. The "Tiangong Class" activity, jointly organised by the Hong Kong SAR government, the Macao SAR government and the China Manned Space Agency, includes an expert lecture, an in-orbit demonstration and a student question-and-answer session. The Education Bureau will arrange for teachers and students in primary and secondary schools to watch the live broadcast on campuses on the day of the event. The "Tiangong Class" Hong Kong and Macao Designated Session builds a bridge for learning and exploration connecting Earth and space, guiding young people in the two SARs to gain a deeper understanding of the remarkable achievements of the country's manned space development, the spokesman said. Live broadcast of the event will be made available online on multiple government websites, including the Information Services Department's website, the news.gov.hk Facebook page, as well as the "A Shared Cosmic Vision for National Rejuvenation" thematic website. In addition, Radio Television Hong Kong and other local television stations will also arrange live broadcasts. Edited by Azam Khan
body.zh: 港澳师生很快将有机会观看目前在天宫空间站的三名神舟二十三号航天员的科学实验现场，其中包括香港首位航天员黎嘉英。香港特区政府发言人周六在公告中表示，“天宫班”港澳专场将是在太空独特环境下为学生进行的一次有价值的航天科普教育活动。 “天宫课堂”活动由香港特别行政区政府、澳门特别行政区政府和中国载人航天工程局联合举办，内容包括专家讲座、在轨演示和学生问答环节。教育局将于活动当天安排中小学师生到校园观看直播。发言人表示，“天宫班”港澳专场搭建了连接地球和太空的学习探索桥梁，引导港澳青少年更深入地了解国家载人航天发展的卓越成就。活动将于多个政府网站进行网上直播，包括政府新闻处网站、政府新闻网Facebook专页，以及“民族复兴共享宇宙愿景”专题网站。此外，香港电台及其他本地电视台也将安排现场直播。阿扎姆·汗编辑

reflection.en: The vastness of space and the ingenuity of human exploration can inspire awe. As students witness experiments from the Tiangong Space Station, they are reminded of the incredible scale of creation and the human capacity to explore it. It is a moment to ponder our place in the cosmos, a place Yahweh has so wonderfully designed.
reflection.zh: 太空的浩瀚和人类探索的智慧能激发敬畏之心。当学生们观看天宫空间站的实验直播时，他们会被提醒受造界的宏大规模以及人类探索它的能力。这是一个思考我们在宇宙中位置的时刻，一个雅伟如此奇妙地设计的居所。

verse.textEn: What is mankind that you are mindful of them, human beings that you care for them?
verse.textZh: 人算什么，你竟顾念他？

title.en: China artists quit S.Korea art show after organisers let ‘Taiwan’ be used in name of exhibition
title.zh: 中国艺术家因“台湾”参展名称退出韩国艺术展

summary.en: Chinese artists have withdrawn from a major South Korean art exhibition, the Gwangju Biennale, after organizers allowed the name "Taiwan" to be used in an exhibition title. This action has drawn criticism from China and highlights the ongoing political sensitivities surrounding cross-strait relations.
summary.zh: 中国艺术家已退出韩国光州双年展，原因是组织者允许在一场展览的名称中使用“台湾”一词。此举引发了中国的批评，并凸显了海峡两岸关系中持续存在的政治敏感性。

body.en: Chinese artists withdrew from a major South Korean art show after organisers allowed “Taiwan” to be used in the name of an exhibition, officials said Thursday, as China issued a rebuke. Gwangju Biennale. Photo: Gwangju Biennale. The Gwangju Biennale, one of Asia’s largest contemporary art events, is due to open Saturday, with its Pavilion Project bringing together artists from around the world at venues across the southwestern city. The dispute began after Taiwanese artists said organisers had initially agreed to call their exhibition the “Taiwan Pavilion”, but changed the name in June to “NTMoFA”, the acronym for Taiwan’s National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts. The change was made “without the consent of the participating team, and brutally erased Taiwan from the poster,” the artists said in a joint statement last month, accusing organisers of “political censorship”. China insists Taiwan is part of its territory and has threatened to use force to annex the self-ruled island of more than 23 million people. Last week, the Gwangju Biennale foundation reversed course and agreed to restore the name “Taiwan Pavilion”. Chinese artists then halted preparations for their own pavilion, and on Thursday, the Chinese artists announced they would formally withdraw, according to local media footage. A spokesperson for the foundation told AFP: “We have confirmation the Chinese artists are withdrawing from the biennale.” China’s consulate general in Gwangju said Biennale organisers “openly allowed the Taiwan region of China to participate in the exhibition using a name that is completely inconsistent with its status.” “This constitutes a serious violation of the One China principle,” it said, adding: “We once again urge the organisers of the Gwangju Biennale to immediately rectify their wrongdoing.” South Korea’s foreign ministry spoke up to calm the row, saying that the “government’s basic position regarding Taiwan remains unchanged”. Taiwan’s flag. Photo: Walid Berrazeg/HKFP. The ministry said the decision was made in the cultural and artistic sphere, and “is unrelated to the South Korean government’s position regarding Taiwan.” “We hope that this issue will not affect South Korea-China relations or exchanges and cooperation between the two countries,” they added.
body.zh: 官员周四表示，在组织者允许在展览名称中使用“台湾”一词后，中国艺术家退出了韩国的一场大型艺术展，中国对此予以谴责。光州双年展。照片：光州双年展。亚洲最大的当代艺术活动之一光州双年展将于周六开幕，其展馆项目将来自世界各地的艺术家聚集在这座西南部城市的各个场馆。争议始于台湾艺术家表示，主办方最初同意将他们的展览命名为“台湾馆”，但在六月将其名称改为“NTMoFA”，即台湾国立台湾美术馆的缩写。艺术家们在上个月的一份联合声明中表示，这一改变是“未经参赛团队同意的，并且残酷地将台湾从海报上抹掉”，并指责组织者进行“政治审查”。中国坚称台湾是其领土的一部分，并威胁要使用武力吞并这个拥有超过 2300 万人口的自治岛屿。上周，光州双年展基金会改变立场，同意恢复“台湾馆”名称。据当地媒体报道，中国艺术家随后停止了自己展馆的准备工作，周四，中国艺术家宣布正式退出。该基金会的发言人告诉法新社：“我们已确认中国艺术家将退出双年展。”中国驻光州总领事馆表示，双年展组织者“公然允许中国台湾地区使用与其地位完全不符的名称参加展览”。 “这严重违反了一个中国原则，”声明称，并补充说：“我们再次敦促光州双年展的组织者立即纠正错误行为。”韩国外交部发声平息争端，称“政府对台湾的基本立场没有改变”。台湾的国旗。照片：Walid Berrazeg/HKFP。韩国文化部表示，这一决定是在文化艺术领域做出的，“与韩国政府对台湾的立场无关”。他们补充说：“我们希望这个问题不会影响韩中关系或两国之间的交流与合作。”

reflection.en: The Gwangju Biennale dispute, where Chinese artists withdrew over the naming of a Taiwanese exhibition, illustrates how political sensitivities can disrupt cultural exchange. The desire for peace and harmonious relations, as urged in Romans 12:18, is challenged when nationalistic sentiments lead to withdrawal rather than dialogue.
reflection.zh: 光州双年展的争端，中国艺术家因台湾展览的命名问题而退出，说明了政治敏感性如何扰乱文化交流。罗马书12章18节所敦促的和平与和谐关系之愿望，在民族主义情绪导致退出而非对话时受到挑战。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: HKFP Lens: ‘Love at last sight’ – bidding farewell to Hong Kong’s modernist General Post Office after 50 years
title.zh: HKFP镜头：“最后的凝视之爱”——告别香港50年的现代主义邮政总局

summary.en: When Hong Kong's General Post Office was constructed in Central fifty years ago, conservationists lamented the demolition of the building it replaced. The former General Post Office was an architectural masterpiece of the Edwardian era, featuring grand archways and granite veranda pillars under a distinctive facade of...
summary.zh: 五十年前，当香港邮政总局在香港岛中环建成时，保育人士对它取代的旧建筑被拆毁感到惋惜。旧邮政总局是一座爱德华时代建筑的杰作，拥有宏伟的拱门和花岗岩门廊柱，以及独特的玫瑰色厦门砖外墙，这被认为是抵御南中国海岸风暴的耐用性标杆。邮政总局位于干诺道2号的底层入口。十多年前，香港历史博物馆前总馆长曾称赞它为“香港最美丽的建筑”。

body.en: When the General Post Office was built in Central half a century ago, conservationists mourned the loss of the building it replaced. Exterior of the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The old General Post Office was a marvel of Edwardian architecture: sweeping archways and granite veranda pillars beneath a distinctive façade of rose-coloured Amoy brick – the gold standard for durability on the storm-lashed South China coast. The GPO’s ground-floor entrance at 2 Connaught Place. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Just over a decade ago, the former chief curator of the Hong Kong Museum of History crowned it “Hong Kong’s most beautiful building” when it stood at the site of what is now World-Wide House. For others , its loss ranked alongside the demolition of the old Hong Kong Club as one of the greatest architectural crimes the city has committed against itself. Post Office Private Boxes on the second floor of the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. But fast-forward to 2026 and accolades are now pouring in for the much-maligned replacement structure. Ahead of its own demolition, the current modernist General Post Office, erected in 1976, is belatedly finding recognition as an icon of modern Hong Kong heritage. Service counters in the General Post Office. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Crouching just five storeys above the Central harbourfront – its planned stature stunted so as to preserve the sea view from Jardine House – the post office’s sharp lines and white concrete walls buck against its ornate predecessor. Customers queue in the main hall of the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Yet, in retrospect, it’s clear to see how these design choices reflected the society it was born into: one that, by the 1970s, prized simple, utilitarian structures that served a rapidly growing population first and foremost. In the headlong rush to modernise and develop, form followed function – and decoration was optional. Towers of parcels wait at a GPO counter. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. It’s not the first time a modern landmark has, with time, won the hearts of Hongkongers. A row of desks in the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The looming demise of the GPO’s erstwhile neighbour, Edinburgh Place Ferry Pier, sparked spirited protests and a sit-in by conservationists in 2006. Although they failed to protect the 1950s landmark, many saw the movement as a watershed moment that led to the localist movement and pro-democracy mobilisation of the 2010s. A stairwell inside the GPO. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. In North Point, efforts to save the mid-century State Theatre have been ongoing for a decade, with some hard-won concessions from the government and developers. A second-floor window in the GPO overlooks the Court of Final Appeal Building....
body.zh: 半个世纪前，当邮政总局在中环建成时，自然资源保护主义者对它所取代的建筑物的损失表示哀悼。邮政总局的外观。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。旧邮政总局是爱德华时代建筑的奇迹：宽阔的拱门和花岗岩阳台柱子位于独特的玫瑰色厦门砖外墙之下，这是暴风雨肆虐的华南海岸耐用性的黄金标准。 GPO 底层入口位于康诺特广场 2 号。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。就在十多年前，当它矗立在现在的环球大厦旧址时，香港历史博物馆前总馆长将其誉为“香港最美丽的建筑”。对于其他人来说，它的损失与拆除旧香港会一样，是这座城市对自己犯下的最大的建筑罪行之一。邮局私人信箱位于 GPO 二楼。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。但快进到 2026 年，备受诟病的替代结构获得的赞誉纷至沓来。建于 1976 年的现代主义风格的邮政总局在被拆除之前，后来才被认为是现代香港遗产的象征。邮政总局的服务柜台。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。邮局坐落在中环海滨上方仅五层楼高处，其规划的高度被限制，以保留怡和大厦的海景。邮局的锐利线条和白色混凝土墙与其华丽的前身形成鲜明对比。顾客在 GPO 大厅排队。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。然而，回想起来，我们可以清楚地看到这些设计选择如何反映了它诞生的社会：到了 20 世纪 70 年代，这个社会推崇简单、实用的结构，首先是为快速增长的人口服务。在现代化和发展的急速推进中，形式追随功能——装饰是可选的。 GPO 柜台前堆满了包裹。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。随着时间的推移，现代地标赢得了香港人的心，这并不是第一次。 GPO 中的一排办公桌。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 2006 年，GPO 的昔日邻居爱丁堡广场渡轮码头即将消亡，引发了自然资源保护主义者的激烈抗议和静坐。尽管他们未能保护 1950 年代的地标，但许多人认为这场运动是导致 2010 年代地方主义运动和民主动员的分水岭。 GPO 内的楼梯间。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。在北角，拯救中世纪国家剧院的努力已经持续了十年，政府和开发商做出了一些来之不易的让步。总督察署二楼的一扇窗户俯瞰着终审法院大楼……

reflection.en: For fifty years, the General Post Office building stood in Central, a landmark that has now reached the end of its public service life. The story notes the lament of conservationists for the beautiful Edwardian building it replaced, highlighting the passage of time and the inevitable changes that come with it. Ecclesiastes reminds us that 'there is a time...
reflection.zh: 五十年来，邮政总局大楼矗立在中环，如今它已走到了公众服务生涯的尽头。故事提到保育人士对它取代的爱德华时代美丽建筑的惋惜，突显了时间的流逝以及随之而来的不可避免的变化。《传道书》提醒我们，“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时”，这是建筑物的兴衰和城市发展的变迁所体现的真理。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Ruth Wang, Chinese lawyer for underground church, flees to Taiwan – rights group
title.zh: 中国地下教会律师王瑞德逃往台湾——人权组织

summary.en: Taiwan announced on Friday that it has provided 'temporary accommodation' to a Chinese citizen, following a report by a human rights group that a lawyer representing detained leaders of an underground church in Beijing had fled to the island. Taiwan's top China policy body did not identify the individual, but ChinaAid...
summary.zh: 台湾周五宣布已为一名中国公民提供“临时住所”，此前一个人权组织报道称，一名代表北京地下教会被拘留领袖的律师已逃往该岛。台湾最高中国事务委员会未透露该人身份，但 ChinaAid 称，王瑞德（Ruth Wang），北京维诚律师事务所的合伙人，周三抵达台湾，“寻求台湾当局的保护”。ChinaAid...

body.en: Taiwan said Friday it has provided “temporary accommodation” to a Chinese citizen, after a rights group reported that a lawyer representing detained leaders of an underground church in Beijing had fled to the island. Ruth Wang. Photo: Ruth Wang. Taiwan’s top China policy body did not identify the person, but ChinaAid said Ruth Wang, a partner at Vdoor Law Firm in Beijing, had arrived in Taiwan on Wednesday “seeking protection from Taiwanese authorities”. ChinaAid said Wang was a lawyer for detained leaders of Zion Church, one of China’s unregistered churches that some Christians choose to worship at instead of state-sanctioned ones regulated by the government. “Wang and her family left China because of concerns about increasing government pressure related to her legal work and representation of detained Beijing Zion Church leaders,” ChinaAid said on Thursday, citing information it had obtained and reporting by the Associated Press news agency. Taiwan’s Mainland Affairs Council issued a brief statement on Friday in response to media reports about a “Chinese lawyer seeking assistance in Taiwan”. It said the government has provided a “Chinese national transferring through a Taiwanese airport” with “temporary accommodation on humanitarian grounds and is following up on the matter”. Members of the Zion Church, including the founder Ezra Jin, were detained in October on “suspicion of the illegal use of information networks”. China released Jin, also known by his Chinese name Mingri, in July after US President Donald Trump raised his case with Xi Jinping. Photo: X. Eight of the Zion Church members detained in October are still being held, ChinaAid said. China’s ruling Communist Party has historically regarded organised religion with suspicion, and under Xi has tightened scrutiny of unofficial groups. Authorities have been cracking down on unregistered churches in recent months.
body.zh: 台湾周五表示，已为一名中国公民提供“临时住所”，此前一个人权组织报道称，一名代表北京地下教会被拘留领导人的律师已逃往台湾。王露丝.照片：王露丝。台湾最高的中国政策机构没有透露此人的身份，但对华援助协会表示，北京Vdoor律师事务所合伙人王露丝已于周三抵达台湾“寻求台湾当局的保护”。对华援助协会表示，王是锡安教会被拘留领导人的律师，锡安教会是中国未注册的教会之一，一些基督徒选择在该教会做礼拜，而不是政府监管的国家认可的教会。对华援助协会周四援引其获得的信息和美联社的报道称，“王和她的家人离开中国是因为担心政府在她的法律工作和代表被拘留的北京锡安教会领袖方面施加的压力越来越大。”台湾陆委会周五发表简短声明，回应媒体有关“中国律师在台寻求援助”的报道。声明称，政府已“出于人道主义理由为一名通过台湾机场转机的中国公民提供临时住宿，并正在跟进此事”。锡安教会成员，包括创始人Ezra Jin，于10月因“涉嫌非法利用信息网络”被拘留。在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普向习近平提出此事后，中国于 7 月释放了金明日。对华援助协会表示，10 月份被拘留的 8 名锡安教会成员仍被关押。中国执政的共产党历来对有组织的宗教持怀疑态度，在习近平的领导下，加强了对非官方团体的审查。近几个月来，当局一直在打击未注册的教堂。

reflection.en: In a world where many voices are silenced, the courage of individuals like Ruth Wang, who advocate for the vulnerable, shines brightly. Her flight to Taiwan underscores the risks taken by those who defend religious freedom and seek justice for the oppressed. May we be inspired to lend our voices to those who cannot speak for themselves, reflecting the...
reflection.zh: 在一个许多声音被压制的世界里，像王瑞德（Ruth Wang）这样为弱势群体辩护的人的勇气闪耀着光芒。她逃往台湾，凸显了那些捍卫宗教自由和为受压迫者寻求正义的人所冒的风险。愿我们受到启发，为那些无法为自己发声的人发出声音，体现神圣的呼召，为无助者争取权益。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Shein shares slide on fast-fashion retailer’s stock market debut
title.zh: Shein股票上市首日下跌，快时尚零售商估值缩水

summary.en: Shares of the fast-fashion brand Shein fell as much as 10% on their debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The company, founded in China and now headquartered in Singapore, was valued at just over $26 billion, a significant drop from its previous valuation of nearly $100 billion.
summary.zh: 快时尚品牌Shein在香港证券交易所上市首日股价下跌高达10%。这家中国创立、现总部设在新加坡的公司，估值略高于260亿美元，远低于其此前近1000亿美元的估值。

body.en: Hong Kong flotation at $26bn by firm once valued at $100bn follows failure to list in US and UK Shares in the fast-fashion brand Shein slumped by as much as 10% as the China-founded company made its long-anticipated trading debut on the Hong Kong stock exchange. The Singapore-headquartered company, once valued at almost $100bn (£74bn), went public on Tuesday pricing shares at HK$48.56, valuing the business at just over $26bn. Continue reading...
body.zh: 曾估值 1000 亿美元的公司在香港发行 260 亿美元，此前该公司未能在美国和英国上市。快时尚品牌 Shein 在香港证券交易所首次上市后，其股价下跌了 10%。这家总部位于新加坡的公司一度估值近 1000 亿美元（740 亿英镑），周二上市，股价为 48.56 港元，业务估值略高于 260 亿美元。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The dramatic drop in Shein's valuation on its Hong Kong stock market debut, from nearly $100 billion to just over $26 billion, serves as a potent reminder of the volatile nature of commerce. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans, a wisdom that transcends market highs and lows.
reflection.zh: Shein在香港股市上市首日估值从近1000亿美元暴跌至略高于260亿美元，这有力地提醒我们商业的波动性。箴言16:3鼓励我们将所做的事交托给雅伟，信靠祂必成就我们的计划，这智慧超越了市场的起伏。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: The London stock market dodged a bullet with Shein | Nils Pratley
title.zh: Shein 避开了伦敦股市的险球

summary.en: China's fashion giant Shein will list in Hong Kong with a reduced price tag, raising significant questions about its business model. In an alternate scenario, Shein might have been preparing to list on the London stock market, a prospect that politicians from both major parties had actively pursued, seeing it as a...
summary.zh: 中国的时尚巨头Shein将以缩水的估值在香港上市，这引发了对其商业模式的重大疑问。在另一种可能的情况下，Shein本可能正准备在那斯达克上市，而英国两党政治家都曾积极争取，认为这将为伦敦的上市市场注入活力，并彰显英国对国际资本的开放态度。

body.en: China’s fashion giant will list in Hong Kong with a shrunken price tag – and big questions over its business model In a parallel world, we might now be preparing for the arrival on the London stock market of Shein, the giant Chinese-founded fast-fashion retailer. Or it could have happened already. The possibility of a London flotation was a running story during 2024 and into last year as politicians from both main parties engaged in behind-the-scenes wooing. Shein was seen as a shot of tech adrenalin for a listless local listings scene, and an opportunity to advertise the UK’s openness to international capital. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国时尚巨头将以更低的价格在香港上市——其商业模式面临重大疑问在另一个平行世界中，我们现在可能正在为中国创办的大型快时尚零售商 Shein 登陆伦敦股市做准备。或者它可能已经发生了。 2024 年和去年，随着两个主要政党的政治家都在幕后拉拢，在伦敦上市的可能性一直是一个热门话题。 Shein 被视为为当地无精打采的上市场景注入一剂科技肾上腺素，也是宣传英国对国际资本开放的机会。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The decision for Shein to list in Hong Kong rather than London involves complex business strategies and political considerations. This reminds us of the importance of committing all our endeavors, whether in business or public life, to God's guidance. May our plans be aligned with His will, seeking wisdom and integrity in every venture.
reflection.zh: Shein最终选择在香港而非伦敦上市，这背后涉及复杂的商业策略和政治考量。这提醒我们，将我们所有的事业，无论是在商业还是公共领域，都交托给雅伟的引导是何等重要。愿我们的计划都能合乎祂的旨意，在每一次的尝试中寻求智慧与正直。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: The Guardian view on the Tiananmen vigil convictions: Hong Kong too has been silenced. Others should speak out | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》评论：天安门集会定罪，香港亦被噤声。他人应发声

summary.en: Two activists who organized commemorations of China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. For decades, Hong Kong was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked, but freedoms have been crushed since 2019.
summary.zh: 两名组织纪念中国1989年镇压民主抗议活动的活动家面临牢狱之灾。几十年来，香港是中国唯一能够公开纪念这一日期的地点，但自2019年以来，自由已被压制。

body.en: Two activists who organised commemorations of the bloody crackdown on China’s 1989 pro-democracy protests now face jail. Remembering is not a crime For decades, Hong Kong mourned when the mainland could not. Its huge annual Tiananmen vigil kept alive the memory of the 1989 pro-reform protests in Beijing, and of the massacre that suppressed them. Along with Macau, it was the only place in China where the anniversary could be publicly marked and the truth preserved. But the crackdown on the 2019 uprising in Hong Kong has crushed the freedoms that the region once enjoyed. That year’s vigil was the last. On Friday, two leaders of the Hong Kong Alliance, which organised the commemoration, were convicted of incitement to subversion under the draconian national security law. Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, and Chow Hang-tung, 41, face up to 10 years in jail. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 两名组织纪念中国 1989 年民主抗议活动血腥镇压的活动人士现在面临牢狱之灾。铭记不是犯罪 几十年来，香港一直在哀悼，而大陆却无法铭记。一年一度的天安门守夜活动让人们牢牢记住了1989年北京支持改革的抗议活动以及镇压抗议活动的大屠杀。它与澳门一样，是中国唯一可以公开纪念这一周年并保存真相的地方。但2019年香港起义的镇压摧毁了该地区曾经享有的自由。那一年的守夜活动是最后一次。周五，组织这次纪念活动的香港联盟的两名领导人根据严厉的国家安全法被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。 69 岁的李卓人和 41 岁的周恒东将面临最高 10 年的监禁。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The silencing of Hong Kong's annual Tiananmen vigil is a stark reminder that memory and public mourning can be criminalized. The prophet Amos declared, 'Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!' May the courage of those who seek to remember inspire others to speak out against injustice, allowing truth and remembrance to...
reflection.zh: 香港一年一度的天安门悼念活动被噤声，这严峻地提醒我们，记忆和公开哀悼可能被视为犯罪。先知阿摩司宣告说：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔！”愿那些寻求纪念者所展现的勇气，能激励他人发声反对不公，让真理和记忆得以自由流淌。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: Germany's Isar Aerospace launches rocket into orbit from Norway
title.zh: 德国 Isar Aerospace 从挪威发射火箭进入轨道

summary.en: Germany's Isar Aerospace successfully launched a rocket into orbit from Norway on Saturday. This achievement marks a significant step in Europe's efforts to independently and economically send satellites into space, with the company celebrating it as the first time a privately developed rocket reached orbit from...
summary.zh: 德国的 Isar Aerospace 公司于周六成功地从挪威发射了一枚火箭进入轨道。这一成就标志着欧洲在能够独立且经济地将卫星送入太空方面迈出了重要一步，该公司庆祝这是欧洲大陆首次成功发射私营企业研发的火箭进入轨道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Germany's Isar Aerospace launched a rocket into orbit from Norway on Saturday as Europe races to boost its ability to economically send satellites into space independently of the United States.

Isar's 28-meter-long (92-foot-long) two-stage Spectrum rocket blasted off shortly after 2000 GMT from Andoya Spaceport, north of the Arctic Circle, the company said.

"We're in orbit! And just made European history: This is the first time a privately developed rocket reached orbit from continental Europe," the company said on X of the launch from the Norwegian spaceport Andoya.

About 10 minutes into the mission, dubbed "Onward and Upward," the video transmission cut out after the rocket exceeded the maximum range for connection.

"Germany has spaceflight capabilities," said the Ministry for Research, Technology and Space on X, hailing a "milestone that impressively demonstrates our country's innovative strength and technical expertise."

The launch follows months of delays caused by either technical or safety issues, and a test flight in March 2025 in which a Spectrum plunged back to Earth and exploded.

Once ready for serial production, the Spectrum will be tasked with sending civilian and military satellites into low Earth orbit a few hundred kilometers above the ground.

The Spectrum can haul about one tonne of payload, and Isar says its plant near Munich will be able to make more than 30 rockets per year.

While France's Arianespace has long operated from French Guiana, Europe is betting on competition between Isar and other companies to more cheaply launch satellites in the future, as Elon Musk's SpaceX has done in the United States.

"We need capacity. We need independence," Chancellor Friedrich Merz said in March while visiting the Andoya facility with Norway's prime minister.

"For far too long we have relied on other delivery systems and other nations around the world."

Speaking in June at the International Aerospace Exhibition in Berlin, Merz said, "Space is not only crucial for our security, but it is also becoming an increasingly important part of our economic sphere."

The launch comes as President Donald Trump has badly shaken European trust in the NATO alliance, with Europe worrying about its dependence on America, including for space launch capabilities.

German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius has announced a 35 billion euro (over $40 billion) drive by 2030 to build out space capacity.

Master's in physics with research experience. Long-time science news enthusiast. Plays key role in Science X's editorial success. Full profile →
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 德国伊萨尔航空航天公司周六从挪威发射了一枚火箭进入轨道，欧洲竞相提高独立于美国、经济地将卫星送入太空的能力。 该公司表示，Isar 的 28 米长（92 英尺长）两级 Spectrum 火箭在格林威治标准时间 2000 年之后不久从北极圈以北的安多亚航天港发射升空。 该公司在挪威安多亚航天港发射时表示：“我们已经进入轨道！并且刚刚创造了欧洲历史：这是私人开发的火箭首次从欧洲大陆进入轨道。” 任务进行了大约 10 分钟，被称为“前进和向上”，在火箭超出最大连接范围后，视频传输中断。 德国研究、技术和航天部在 X 上表示：“德国拥有航天能力，这是一个里程碑，令人印象深刻地展示了我们国家的创新实力和技术专长。” 此次发射因技术或安全问题而延迟了数月，并在 2025 年 3 月进行了一次试飞，其中一架 Spectrum 坠落地球并爆炸。 一旦准备好进行批量生产，Spectrum 将负责将民用和军用卫星送入距地面数百公里的近地轨道。 Spectrum 可以运载大约一吨的有效载荷，Isar 表示其位于慕尼黑附近的工厂每年将能够生产 30 多枚火箭。 虽然法国的阿丽亚娜航天公司长期以来一直在法属圭亚那运营，但欧洲正在押注于 Isar 和其他公司之间的竞争，以便在未来以更便宜的价格发射卫星，就像埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX 在美国所做的那样。 “我们需要产能。我们需要独立，”总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨在三月份与挪威首相一起参观安多亚工厂时说道。 “长期以来，我们一直依赖其他运输系统和世界各地的其他国家。” 默茨六月在柏林国际航空航天展览会上发表讲话时表示，“太空不仅对我们的安全至关重要，而且也正在成为我们经济领域日益重要的一部分。” 这次发射正值唐纳德·特朗普总统严重动摇了欧洲对北约联盟的信任，欧洲担心其对美国的依赖，包括太空发射能力。 德国国防部长鲍里斯·皮斯托利斯 (Boris Pistorius) 宣布，到 2030 年将投入 350 亿欧元（超过 400 亿美元）来建设太空能力。 物理学硕士，具有研究经验。长期科学新闻爱好者。在 Science X 的编辑成功中发挥着关键作用。完整档案 →

reflection.en: The successful launch of Isar Aerospace's rocket represents a culmination of dedicated effort and planning. It's a reminder that even as we pursue technological advancements and strive for ambitious goals, committing our endeavors to God's guidance can lead to success and fulfillment. May we always seek wisdom and purpose in our work, recognizing that true...
reflection.zh: Isar Aerospace 火箭的成功发射，代表了辛勤付出和周密计划的成果。它提醒我们，即使在追求技术进步和实现宏伟目标的过程中，将我们的努力交托给神的指引，也能带来成功和满足。愿我们永远在工作中寻求智慧和目标，认识到真正的成就源于将我们的计划与祂的旨意相符。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Indonesia’s most dangerous fires are burning underground
title.zh: 印度尼西亚最危险的火灾正在地下燃烧

summary.en: Indonesia's peat fires are starting early in the 2026 season due to a strengthening El Niño and severe drought, causing wetlands to dry out and leading to fires that can smolder underground for months. These fires are particularly destructive, releasing high levels of fine particles and other pollutants.
summary.zh: 由于厄尔尼厄斯增强和严重干旱，印度尼西亚的泥炭火在2026年火灾季提前爆发，导致湿地干涸，并引发了可能在地表下缓慢燃烧数月的火灾。这些火灾尤其具有破坏性，释放出高含量的细颗粒物和其他污染物。

body.en:
Tropical peatland fires rank among the most dangerous and stubborn fires on Earth. Instead of racing through trees and vegetation, these fires smolder through dried wetland soils and large deposits of peat, often continuing underground at relatively low temperatures. That makes them extremely difficult to extinguish and exceptionally polluting.

By one estimate , peat fires produce three times more fine particulate matter than other tropical forest fires, along with five times more sulfur dioxide, three times more organic carbon, and twice as much methane and carbon monoxide.

Indonesia's 2026 fire season was already underway when the MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) instrument aboard NASA's Aqua satellite captured an image of the region on September 1, 2026.

On the annotated map , each red dot represents a "fire detection." This means the satellite sensor and an algorithm identified a pixel containing thermal anomalies associated with fire. A single fire can produce multiple detections.

Peat fires are a persistent problem in Indonesia, which contains about 36 percent of the world's tropical peatlands. During severe droughts, these normally wet landscapes can dry enough to ignite. Over the past three decades, such conditions have repeatedly produced long-lasting fires that blanket large areas in smoke for weeks and disrupt the lives of millions of people.

Wildfires occur in Indonesia every year, but some of the most destructive seasons in recent decades came during El Niño, particularly in 1997 and 2015.

NOAA assessed El Niño as present and strengthening in August 2026. The climate pattern commonly reduces rainfall across Indonesia. The drying can become even more pronounced when El Niño occurs alongside a positive phase of the Indian Ocean Dipole, which was also underway.

"Indonesia is only about three weeks into its fire season, but we're seeing fire activity track sharply upward, similar to 2015," said Robert Field, a Columbia University researcher who developed a tool called the Global Fire Weather Database that produces experimental, real-time fire weather forecasts.

"The strong El Niño is making the dry season drier over the fire-prone parts of the country and exacerbating burning -- just as we anticipated it would," he said.

The comparison with 2015 is significant. After more than three months of burning that year, Indonesia's fires had emitted 1.75 billion tons of greenhouse gas equivalents -- more than Japan emits in an entire year. By September 2, the 2026 fires had been burning for about a month and had already released roughly 10 percent of the amount produced during the 2015 crisis.

Indonesia was also experiencing severe, widespread drought during the summer of 2026, much as it...
body.zh: 热带泥炭地火灾是地球上最危险、最顽固的火灾之一。这些火灾不是在树木和植被中蔓延，而是在干燥的湿地土壤和大量泥炭沉积物中阴燃，通常在相对较低的温度下持续在地下。这使得它们极难扑灭，而且污染特别严重。 据估计，泥炭火灾产生的细颗粒物比其他热带森林火灾多三倍，二氧化硫多五倍，有机碳多三倍，甲烷和一氧化碳多两倍。 当 NASA 的 Aqua 卫星上的 MODIS（中分辨率成像光谱仪）仪器于 2026 年 9 月 1 日拍摄到该地区的图像时，印度尼西亚 2026 年火灾季节已经开始。 在带注释的地图上，每个红点代表一个“火灾探测”。这意味着卫星传感器和算法识别出包含与火灾相关的热异常的像素。一次火灾可以产生多次检测。 泥炭火灾是印度尼西亚持续存在的问题，该国拥有世界上约 36% 的热带泥炭地。在严重干旱期间，这些通常潮湿的景观可能会干燥到足以点燃。在过去的三十年里，这种情况一再引发持久火灾，使大片地区笼罩在烟雾中长达数周，扰乱了数百万人的生活。 印度尼西亚每年都会发生野火，但近几十年来最具破坏性的季节发生在厄尔尼诺现象期间，特别是 1997 年和 2015 年。 美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 评估厄尔尼诺现象确实存在，并于 2026 年 8 月加强。这种气候模式通常会减少印度尼西亚各地的降雨量。当厄尔尼诺现象与同时发生的印度洋偶极子正位相同时发生时，干燥现象会变得更加明显。 哥伦比亚大学研究人员罗伯特·菲尔德（Robert Field）开发了一种名为“全球火灾天气数据库”的工具，该工具可生成实验性的实时火灾天气预报。 他说：“正如我们预期的那样，强烈的厄尔尼诺现象正在使该国火灾多发地区的旱季变得更加干燥，并加剧燃烧。” 与2015年的比较是显着的。那一年，经过三个多月的燃烧，印度尼西亚的大火已排放了 17.5 亿吨温室气体当量，比日本全年的排放量还多。到 9 月 2 日，2026 年的大火已经燃烧了大约一个月，释放的热量大约是 2015 年危机期间的 10%。 印度尼西亚在 2026 年夏季也经历了严重、大范围的干旱，...

reflection.en: The news from Indonesia describes peat fires burning insidiously underground, a stark reminder of how human actions can damage the environment. Genesis 2:15 calls us to 'tend and keep' the earth. These fires, releasing harmful pollutants, represent a failure in that stewardship, impacting both the local environment and potentially the global climate.
reflection.zh: 来自印度尼西亚的新闻描述了泥炭火在地下悄无声息地燃烧，这严峻地提醒我们人类的行为如何能够破坏环境。《创世记》2:15呼吁我们“修理、看守”这片土地。这些释放有害污染物的火灾，代表了这种管理上的失败，既影响了当地环境，也可能影响全球气候。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Haze emergency grips Malaysian Borneo town
title.zh: 烟雾紧急情况笼罩马来西亚砂拉越城镇

summary.en: The Malaysian town of Serian in Sarawak, Borneo, is experiencing an air quality emergency due to acrid smoke from transboundary haze originating from widespread fires in Indonesia. Air pollution levels have reached critical points, leading to the declaration of a state of emergency in the district.
summary.zh: 马来西亚砂拉越州砂拉越州的实仁镇正经历一场空气质量紧急事件，原因是来自印度尼西亚大火的跨界烟雾造成的刺鼻烟雾。空气污染水平已达到危急点，导致该地区宣布进入紧急状态。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Acrid smoke hung heavily over the Malaysian town of Serian, seeping into homes and cloaking roadside stalls, as residents navigated an air-quality emergency fueled by transboundary haze from Indonesia's raging fires.

Malaysia declared a state of emergency in Sarawak state's Serian district on Borneo on Friday after air pollution readings reached critical levels.

Toxic haze has shrouded parts of Indonesia and Malaysia for weeks as Jakarta struggles to contain fires that have scorched large tracts of Borneo and Sumatra, with the plumes drifting into neighboring Malaysia, Singapore and Brunei.

In Serian, about 65 kilometers (40 miles) southeast of Sarawak's capital, Kuching, residents tried to carry on with weekend routines but said the thick haze forced them to plan shorter trips to avoid the worst of the smoke.

"I rarely leave the house when it's like this (the haze). I only come out to buy food and groceries, then I'll immediately head home," said Ajen Anak Kunok, 64, a local retired technician.

Ajen told AFP he had spent the past week battling shortness of breath and a sore throat due to the ongoing haze before going to the hospital Saturday for treatment.

But the smoke was difficult to escape even at home, a mere 10 kilometers (six miles) from Indonesia's Kalimantan province, where the fires were raging.

"Even when I turn on the air conditioner, I can still smell the smoke in my house," Ajen said.

Sarawak, which shares a border with Kalimantan, has borne the brunt of pollution in Malaysia.

On Friday, Serian became the first district in the country this year to declare an emergency over worsening air quality when API levels passed 500 and peaked at 512.

Under Malaysian guidelines, API levels above 300 are classified as hazardous, while readings beyond 500 usually trigger consideration of a local emergency.

At the town's markets, the usual bustling throng dwindled, while roadside sellers of Serian's famous durians waited in vain beside their piles of fruit for customers, who came in diminished numbers.

The district's scenic Ranchan Waterfall—usually popular with locals and tourists alike—was unusually quiet, with just a few visitors dotted around.

Roadside durian seller Siaw Thien Ha, 53, said the emergency had already hit his livelihood hard.

He struggled to earn even half of his usual income of 400 ringgit ($98) for the weekend.

"I'm worried that my income will be affected ... But during the durian season, there is money to be made," he told AFP.

"So I don't have a choice but to bring the durians here to sell to support my family," he said.
