body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 马来西亚西连镇上空笼罩着浓浓的刺鼻烟雾，渗入房屋和路边摊位，印度尼西亚肆虐的大火造成的跨境雾霾加剧了空气质量紧急状况，居民们正在应对这种紧急情况。 在空气污染指数达到临界水平后，马来西亚周五宣布婆罗洲沙捞越州西连地区进入紧急状态。 有毒烟雾已经笼罩印度尼西亚和马来西亚部分地区数周之久，雅加达正在努力控制大火，大火烧焦了婆罗洲和苏门答腊岛的大片地区，烟雾飘入邻国马来西亚、新加坡和文莱。 在砂拉越首府古晋东南约 65 公里（40 英里）处的西连，居民试图继续周末的生活，但表示浓雾迫使他们计划较短的行程，以避免最严重的烟雾。 64 岁的当地退休技术员阿金·阿纳克·库诺克 (Ajen Anak Kunok) 说：“在这样的天气（雾霾）下，我很少出门。我只出来买食物和杂货，然后我就会立即回家。” 阿詹告诉法新社，由于持续的雾霾，他过去一周一直在与呼吸短促和喉咙痛作斗争，然后周六前往医院接受治疗。 但即使在家里，烟雾也很难逃逸，这里距离火势肆虐的印度尼西亚加里曼丹省仅 10 公里（6 英里）。 “即使我打开空调，我仍然能闻到家里的烟味，”阿詹说。 与加里曼丹接壤的砂拉越州首当其冲地受到马来西亚污染的影响。 周五，当 API 水平超过 500 并达到峰值 512 时，西连成为今年全国第一个因空气质量恶化而宣布进入紧急状态的地区。 根据马来西亚的指导方针，API 水平超过 300 被归类为危险，而读数超过 500 通常会引发当地紧急情况的考虑。 在镇上的市场上，往常熙熙攘攘的人群减少了，而路边出售西连著名榴莲的小贩在成堆的水果旁边徒劳地等待着顾客，而顾客的数量也减少了。 该地区风景秀丽的 Ranchan 瀑布通常很受当地人和游客的欢迎，但却异常安静，只有少数游客散布在周围。 53 岁的路边榴莲小贩 Siaw Thien Ha 表示，紧急情况已经严重影响了他的生计。 周末他的收入只有平时 400 林吉特（合 98 美元）的一半，他也很难挣到。 “我担心我的收入会受到影响......但在榴莲季节，可以赚钱，”他告诉法新社。 “所以我别无选择，只能把榴莲带到这里卖来养家糊口，”他说。 星期五的...

reflection.en: The persistent haze blanketing Serian is a stark reminder of how environmental crises can inflict prolonged suffering on communities. Even amidst such devastation, the ancient words of Lamentations offer a profound truth: Yahweh's mercies are new each morning. This enduring hope can sustain those facing difficult circumstances, reminding them that even in...
reflection.zh: 笼罩实仁镇的持续烟雾，严峻地提醒着我们环境危机如何给社区带来长久的痛苦。即使在这样的毁灭之中，《耶利米哀歌》中的古老话语提供了一个深刻的真理：雅伟的慈爱每早都是新的。这种持久的希望可以支撑那些面对困境的人们，提醒他们即使在长期的艰难中，怜悯和更新也是可能的。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.en: AI can now control fusion plasma faster than humans can react
title.zh: 人工智能现在可以比人类反应更快地控制聚变等离子体

summary.en: Researchers at Princeton have developed an AI system capable of monitoring and controlling fusion plasma in milliseconds, significantly faster than human operators. This AI, named PACMAN, can predict and mitigate damaging instabilities before they occur, enhancing safety in fusion experiments.
summary.zh: 普林斯顿大学的研究人员开发了一个人工智能系统，能够在毫秒内监测和控制聚变等离子体，其速度远超人类操作员。该人工智能系统名为PACMAN，能够预测并阻止破坏性不稳定的发生，从而提高聚变实验的安全性。

body.en:
In some fusion systems, particles hotter than the core of the sun can become unstable within just a few thousandths of a second. That is far too fast for a human operator to respond. Researchers at the U.S. Department of Energy's (DOE) Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory (PPPL) and Princeton University have developed a new software framework that uses artificial intelligence (AI) to make those rapid decisions while maintaining strict safety controls and leaving people responsible for setting the system's objectives.

The framework is called PACMAN (a novel abbreviation for Prediction And Control using MAchiNe learning). Researchers successfully tested it on a real fusion system in five separate experiments. Its design and initial results are described in a new paper published in the journal Nuclear Fusion .

Fusion has the potential to provide a virtually unlimited supply of electricity. Researchers are exploring several approaches to making fusion practical on Earth, including machines known as tokamaks. These devices rely on powerful magnetic fields to confine a plasma: an electrically charged gas often called the fourth state of matter.

For fusion to continue successfully, the plasma must remain hot, dense, and stable. That requires frequent adjustments to systems such as the tokamak's heating equipment, magnets and gas injectors. Even relatively small disturbances in the plasma, known as instabilities, can grow within milliseconds and disrupt the fusion reaction.

Predicting plasma behavior is another major challenge. Advanced computer simulations can take days or even months to complete. While those tools are valuable for planning future experiments, they are far too slow to guide an experiment in real time when the entire test may last only a few minutes.

"That's great for preparing for the next experiment in a year, but for control we need models that make a decision in the moment," said co-lead author Hiro Farre Kaga, a graduate student in the Princeton Program in Plasma Physics, which is a joint program of Princeton University and PPPL. "Machine learning models can describe the plasma behavior very well, and importantly, they are the only way we have to model the plasma in millisecond times. The speed of these models is what's key for control."

Machine learning has already shown considerable potential for controlling fusion plasmas. However, many previous efforts were developed individually, without a common framework that would make it easy for different models to work together. Fusion systems require multiple models because different parts of the machine and plasma must be monitored and controlled at the same time.

"We developed this framework so that models could communicate, outputs from those models could be shared and we could do...
body.zh: 在某些聚变系统中，比太阳核心更热的粒子可能会在千分之几秒内变得不稳定。对于人类操作员来说，这个速度太快了，无法做出反应。美国能源部 (DOE) 普林斯顿等离子体物理实验室 (PPPL) 和普林斯顿大学的研究人员开发了一种新的软件框架，该框架使用人工智能 (AI) 做出快速决策，同时保持严格的安全控制，并让人们负责设定系统的目标。 该框架称为 PACMAN（使用机器学习进行预测和控制的新缩写）。研究人员在五个独立的实验中成功地在真实的融合系统上对其进行了测试。其设计和初步结果在《核聚变》杂志上发表的一篇新论文中进行了描述。 聚变有潜力提供几乎无限的电力供应。研究人员正在探索几种在地球上实现聚变实用的方法，包括被称为托卡马克的机器。这些设备依靠强大的磁场来限制等离子体：一种带电气体，通常被称为物质的第四态。 为了成功地继续聚变，等离子体必须保持高温、致密和稳定。这需要经常调整托卡马克的加热设备、磁铁和气体注射器等系统。即使等离子体中相对较小的扰动（称为不稳定性）也可能在几毫秒内增长并破坏聚变反应。 预测等离子体行为是另一个重大挑战。高级计算机模拟可能需要几天甚至几个月才能完成。虽然这些工具对于规划未来的实验很有价值，但当整个测试可能只持续几分钟时，它们的速度太慢，无法实时指导实验。 “这对于为一年内的下一个实验做准备非常有用，但为了控制，我们需要能够立即做出决定的模型，”共同主要作者 Hiro Farre Kaga 说，他是普林斯顿大学等离子体物理项目的研究生，该项目是普林斯顿大学和 PPPL 的联合项目。 “机器学习模型可以很好地描述等离子体行为，重要的是，它们是我们在毫秒时间内对等离子体进行建模的唯一方法。这些模型的速度是控制的关键。” 机器学习已经显示出控制聚变等离子体的巨大潜力。然而，之前的许多工作都是单独开发的，没有一个可以让不同模型轻松协同工作的通用框架。聚变系统需要多种模型，因为必须同时监视和控制机器和等离子体的不同部分。 “我们开发了这个框架，以便模型可以通信，这些模型的输出可以共享，我们可以做......

reflection.en: The pace of technological advancement, especially in fields like artificial intelligence, often outstrips our capacity for thoughtful integration. Daniel's prophecy speaks to an era where knowledge rapidly expands, urging us to seek wisdom alongside information, ensuring our tools serve humanity's best interests.
reflection.zh: 技术进步的步伐，尤其是在人工智能等领域，常常超越我们深思熟虑地整合它们的能力。但以理书的预言指向一个知识迅速增长的时代，促使我们在信息之外寻求智慧，确保我们的工具服务于人类的最佳利益。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Litter pick collects 50 bags of rubbish from river
title.zh: 河边拾荒者收集了50袋垃圾

summary.en: A group of volunteers in Durham, England, dedicated to cleaning the River Wear, collected over 50 bags of rubbish during their most recent monthly litter-picking event. The Durham City Riverscape Community, formed before the pandemic, has removed tonnes of waste, including a large refrigerator, and is approaching a...
summary.zh: 在英格兰达勒姆，一个致力于清理韦尔河的志愿者团体在最近一次月度拾荒活动中收集了50多袋垃圾。达勒姆市河流景观社区在疫情前成立，已从河中移除了数吨废物，包括一台大型冰箱，并即将达到收集1000袋垃圾的里程碑。

body.en:
A litter picking group which removes rubbish from a river collected more than 50 bags of rubbish at their latest gathering.

The Durham City Riverscape Community formed just before the coronavirus pandemic to carry out monthly litter picks along the River Wear.

The group estimated it had collected tonnes of waste from the water since the start, including a large fridge earlier this year.

Lead volunteer Graham Hollingwood said the group was approaching the 1,000 bag milestone which "just shows how much work goes into protecting our riverbanks" and the "phenomenal" efforts of volunteers.

He said pulling the full sized fridge freezer out of the river was their biggest challenge to date but the team proved equal to it.

"None of this incredible progress would be possible without the phenomenal, unwavering support of the City of Durham Parish Council," Hollingwood said.

"Their funding, practical backing, and ongoing encouragement give us the resources and confidence we need to keep getting out on the water, tackle massive fly-tipping hazards, and make a genuine, lasting impact on the local environment."

Clerk of the City of Durham Parish Council and co-founder of the litter picking group Adam Shanley said the scale of dedication from volunteers was "extraordinary".

"It is an absolute privilege for the council to support and stand alongside such a proactive, passionate team," he said.

"We will continue to back our volunteers every step of the way as they work tirelessly to safeguard the River Wear for generations to come."

Follow BBC North East on X , external , Facebook , external , Nextdoor and Instagram , external and listen on BBC Sounds .
body.zh: 一个从河里清理垃圾的垃圾收集小组在最近一次聚会中收集了 50 多袋垃圾。 达勒姆市河景社区在冠状病毒大流行之前成立，每月沿威尔河进行垃圾清理。 该组织估计，自成立以来，他们已经从水中收集了数吨废物，其中包括今年早些时候的一台大冰箱。 首席志愿者格雷厄姆·霍林伍德 (Graham Hollingwood) 表示，该组织正在接近 1,000 个袋子的里程碑，这“正好表明为保护我们的河岸付出了多少努力”以及志愿者的“非凡”努力。 他说，将全尺寸的冰箱从河里拉出来是他们迄今为止最大的挑战，但事实证明，团队能够应对这一挑战。 霍林伍德说：“如果没有达勒姆市教区议会坚定不移的大力支持，这些令人难以置信的进展是不可能实现的。” “他们的资金、实际支持和持续的鼓励为我们提供了所需的资源和信心，使我们能够继续出海，解决大规模的飞卸危险，并对当地环境产生真正、持久的影响。” 达勒姆市教区委员会书记员、垃圾分类组织联合创始人亚当·尚利 (Adam Shanley) 表示，志愿者的奉献精神“非同寻常”。 他说：“理事会能够支持并与这样一个积极主动、充满激情的团队并肩作战，绝对是一种荣幸。” “我们将继续支持我们的志愿者，他们为子孙后代不懈地保护威尔河。” 在 X、external、Facebook、external、Nextdoor 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC North East，并收听 BBC Sounds。

reflection.en: The dedication of the Durham City Riverscape Community in collecting 50 bags of rubbish from the River Wear is a powerful example of stewardship. It reminds us that the Earth and its waters are a gift from Yahweh, entrusted to our care, and that diligent, consistent effort can make a tangible difference in preserving its beauty and health.
reflection.zh: 达勒姆市河流景观社区在韦尔河拾起50袋垃圾的奉献精神，是管理受托之物的有力典范。它提醒我们，大地和水是雅伟所赐的礼物，托付给我们照管，而勤奋、持续的努力可以在保护其美丽和健康方面发挥切实的改变作用。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Scientists find a weak spot in one of the deadliest brain cancers
title.zh: 科学家发现一种致命脑癌的弱点

summary.en: Researchers may have found a new way to weaken glioblastoma’s defenses against treatment. Blocking a protein called SET prevented tumors from forming in preclinical models, while targeting related proteins made cancer cells more vulnerable to radiation. The strategy works by restoring activity of PP2A, an enzyme that...
summary.zh: 研究人员可能发现了一种削弱胶质母细胞瘤抵抗治疗的新方法。在临床前模型中，阻断一种名为SET的蛋白质可阻止肿瘤形成，而靶向相关蛋白质则使癌细胞更容易受到辐射的伤害。该策略通过恢复PP2A（一种胶质母细胞瘤细胞似乎会抑制的酶）的活性来起作用。需要进行人体试验以确定该方法是否安全有效。

body.en: Researchers may have found a new way to weaken glioblastoma’s defenses against treatment. Blocking a protein called SET prevented tumors from forming in preclinical models, while targeting related proteins made cancer cells more vulnerable to radiation. The strategy works by restoring activity of PP2A, an enzyme that glioblastoma cells appear to suppress. Human testing will be needed to determine whether the approach is safe and effective.
body.zh: 研究人员可能已经找到了一种削弱胶质母细胞瘤对治疗的防御能力的新方法。阻断一种名为 SET 的蛋白质可以防止临床前模型中肿瘤的形成，而靶向相关蛋白质则使癌细胞更容易受到辐射的影响。该策略通过恢复 PP2A 的活性来发挥作用，PP2A 是胶质母细胞瘤细胞似乎抑制的一种酶。需要进行人体测试来确定该方法是否安全有效。

reflection.en: The relentless pursuit of knowledge, even into the most complex and deadly aspects of creation, reflects a deep human impulse to understand and heal. This scientific endeavor, by observing the intricate workings of a disease, echoes the ancient wisdom that creation itself holds profound lessons. Through careful study of biological processes, scientists...
reflection.zh: 对知识的不懈追求，即使是深入研究创造中最复杂和致命的方面，也反映了人类深刻的理解和治愈的冲动。这项科学探索通过观察疾病的复杂运作，呼应了古老的智慧——创造本身蕴含着深刻的教训。 通过仔细研究生物过程，科学家们发现了对抗痛苦的方法。这与圣经的见解相呼应，即观察自然世界可以带来智慧和理解，为治愈和恢复带来希望。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: How the hair of a museum bear is helping tackle wildlife crime
title.zh: 一只博物馆熊的毛发如何帮助打击野生动物犯罪

summary.en: A forensic science graduate is using hair samples from a 120-year-old taxidermy bear named Boris to develop new techniques for identifying animal hairs in investigations, aiming to combat illegal poaching of modern-day bears.
summary.zh: 一位法证科学研究生正在利用一只名为鲍里斯的、已有120年历史的标本熊的毛发样本，开发新的技术来识别调查中的动物毛发，旨在打击当代熊的非法偷猎。

body.en:
A student has been using hair from a 120-year-old museum exhibit to help find new ways of solving wildlife crime.

The taxidermy bear, known as Boris, is a popular feature at the Museum of Chelmsford and is regarded as its unofficial mascot.

Hayden Leigh, a forensic science graduate at the University of Staffordshire, is using samples taken from his hair to help protect modern-day brown bears from illegal poaching.

His PhD research involves analysing Boris's fur to compare how its characteristics could improve identification of animal hairs during investigations.

Boris arrived at the museum in 1932 amongst a large collection of taxidermy bequeathed by a local game hunter.

Leigh said in the wild the animals were mostly found in places like Romania and Bulgaria as well as Russia.

He said he had been using a microscope to analyse the cuticles, and different layers of the bear's fur as well as its DNA.

Leigh had previously approached about 30 zoos and museums for help with the project before the Museum of Chelmsford said they would lend a hand.

"There's been hundreds of studies done on dog hairs and cat hairs and general domestic animals, and I thought, well, let's make a wider impact than on the wider wildlife crime investigations," he said.

By developing more a cost-effective and reliable alternative to DNA analysis, the aim is to help tackle the illegal poaching and trafficking of wildlife.

"Taxidermy samples from museums can play a valuable role in the research of animal hair within a forensic context, Leigh added.

"In my project, I examined Boris's hair at a microscopic level, assessing the characteristics of the hairs and investigating whether there was any variation across different areas of the body."

Having access to a preserved specimen had also meant an opportunity to examine authentic animal hair in a controlled and ethical way, he said, without needing to disturb a live animal.

Councillor Jennie Lardge, cabinet member for culture and leisure at Chelmsford City Council, acknowledged that taxidermy was often considered a controversial part of museum collections, but said it was "wonderful" that Boris' legacy would be to help protect other animals from illegal hunting.

"It highlights the scientific value of historic taxidermy collections in museums in 2026, and we are delighted that the Museum of Chelmsford has been able to support this important project," she said.

Follow BBC Stoke & Staffordshire on BBC Sounds , Facebook , external , X , external and Instagram , external .
body.zh: 一名学生利用博物馆 120 年前展览中的毛发来帮助寻找解决野生动物犯罪的新方法。 这只被称为“鲍里斯”的动物标本剥制熊是切姆斯福德博物馆的一大特色，并被视为其非官方吉祥物。 斯塔福德郡大学法医学毕业生海登·利 (Hayden Leigh) 正在利用从他的头发中采集的样本来帮助保护现代棕熊免遭非法偷猎。 他的博士研究涉及分析鲍里斯的皮毛，以比较其特征如何在调查过程中提高对动物毛发的识别。 1932 年，鲍里斯 (Boris) 来到博物馆，周围有当地狩猎者遗赠的大量动物标本。 利说，在野外，这些动物大多出现在罗马尼亚、保加利亚以及俄罗斯等地。 他说他一直在使用显微镜来分析熊的角质层、毛皮的不同层以及它的 DNA。 在切姆斯福德博物馆表示愿意提供帮助之前，Leigh 曾向约 30 家动物园和博物馆寻求帮助。 “已经对狗毛、猫毛和一般家畜进行了数百项研究，我想，好吧，让我们产生比更广泛的野生动物犯罪调查更广泛的影响，”他说。 通过开发更具成本效益且可靠的 DNA 分析替代方案，目标是帮助解决野生动物的非法偷猎和贩运问题。 Leigh 补充道：“博物馆的动物标本剥制样本可以在法医学领域的动物毛发研究中发挥重要作用。” “在我的项目中，我在微观层面上检查了鲍里斯的头发，评估头发的特征并调查身体不同部位是否存在任何差异。” 他说，能够接触到保存完好的标本也意味着有机会以受控且合乎道德的方式检查真正的动物毛发，而无需打扰活体动物。 切姆斯福德市议会文化和休闲内阁成员珍妮·拉奇 (Jennie Lardge) 议员承认，动物标本剥制术经常被认为是博物馆藏品中颇具争议的一部分，但她表示，鲍里斯的遗产将有助于保护其他动物免受非法狩猎，这“很棒”。 她说：“它凸显了 2026 年博物馆历史标本剥制术收藏的科学价值，我们很高兴切姆斯福德博物馆能够支持这一重要项目。” 在 BBC Sounds、Facebook、external、X、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Stoke & Staffordshire。

reflection.en: The natural world, even in the form of a museum exhibit, holds secrets that can serve humanity. By carefully studying the fur of Boris the bear, Hayden Leigh seeks to protect living creatures from harm. This reminds us that wisdom and solutions can be found by observing and respecting Yahweh's creation.
reflection.zh: 大自然，即使是一件博物馆的展品，也蕴藏着能服务于人类的秘密。通过仔细研究鲍里斯熊的毛皮，海登·利寻求保护活着的生灵免受伤害。这提醒我们，智慧和解决方案可以在观察和尊重雅伟的创造中找到。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: RSPB marks 50 years at wildlife-rich reserve
title.zh: RSPB庆祝拥有丰富野生动植物保护区50周年

summary.en: The Strumpshaw Fen nature reserve in Norfolk is celebrating its 50th anniversary. Reserve manager Helen Deavin stated that the 450-hectare site, equivalent to 630 football pitches, not only helps rare species survive but thrive, citing examples like nesting bitterns, swallowtail butterflies, and cranes that...
summary.zh: 位于诺福克郡的斯特拉普肖沼泽自然保护区正在庆祝其成立50周年。保护区经理海伦·迪文表示，占地450公顷（相当于630个足球场）的保护区不仅帮助濒危物种生存，而且使其得以繁衍，例如在此筑巢的矛隼、燕尾蝶以及今年夏天成功哺育了一只雏鸟的鹤。

body.en:
A nature reserve tucked away on the Broads and home to some of Norfolk's most threatened wildlife is celebrating 50 years.

Strumpshaw Fen covers 450 hectares (1,112 acres) of diverse wetland — the equivalent of 630 football pitches.

Reserves manager Helen Deavin said the site supported "rare and unusual species", including nesting bitterns, the swallowtail butterfly and a pair of cranes that successfully raised a chick this summer.

"One of the lovely things about Strumpshaw is that the wildlife is quite accessible," added Deavin, who called the reserve a "hidden gem".

Marsh harriers, bearded tits, flocks of waders and overwintering ducks and geese are a regular sight for visitors, along with otters, water voles, fen raft spiders, orchids and rare sharp-leaved pondweed.

"There's this incredible, really quite rare wildlife but actually it's really possible for people to see it, get some great views and really experience the magic of the Broads," added Deavin.

"By developing habitats where wildlife feels safe and can find the right food and places to shelter and raise a family, teams across the years have created a reserve that helps populations of rare species not only survive, but thrive."

She said the summer's heatwaves had been "tough", but they were hoping for a cooler, wetter autumn, with the reserve braced for flood events and "saline surges" with seasonal tides.

Strumpshaw is hosting various events to celebrate the milestone, including guided walks around the site on Sunday.

The reserve started off as unmanaged fenland and was taken over by the RSPB in the mid-1970s.

BBC Look East camera operator Shaun Whitmore has always loved Strumpshaw Fen and in his own words, he explains why.

Away from my job as a BBC TV cameraman, I have always had an interest in wildlife photography, and Strumpshaw is a perfect place to indulge in this passion.

Alongside that, Strumpshaw is somewhere I can take a step back to pause and think about my life.

In 2016, it was the place I went to, when everything in my life became too much for me. Nature provided me with a way out of the breakdown I was having at the time.

On my birthday, in December 2019, Strumpshaw Fen was the place I took my future wife to propose.

I was asked in 2020 to make a film about my favourite place as I was shielding because of the Covid risk - I had to choose Strumpshaw Fen!

Maybe my timing was off, because we went into lockdown two days into the filming. I did make a film and it went out on Look East the following week, showing what we were all missing while we were having to stay indoors for a while.

I have beautiful memories of this stunning part of Norfolk, with its reed beds, grazing marshes, woodland area and river frontage, along with an abundance of birds and other...
body.zh: 位于布罗德兹 (Broads) 的一个自然保护区是诺福克一些最受威胁的野生动物的家园，正在庆祝成立 50 周年。 斯特朗普肖沼泽 (Strumpshaw Fen) 占地 450 公顷（1,112 英亩）的多样化湿地，相当于 630 个足球场。 保护区经理海伦·迪文 (Helen Deavin) 表示，该地点支持“稀有和不寻常的物种”，包括筑巢的麻鹳、燕尾蝴蝶和一对今年夏天成功养育了雏鸟的鹤。 “斯特鲁普肖的一大可爱之处在于，野生动物很容易到达，”迪文补充道，他称该保护区为“隐藏的宝石”。 沼泽鹞、髯山雀、成群的涉禽、越冬的鸭子和鹅是游客的常见景观，此外还有水獭、水田鼠、沼泽蜘蛛、兰花和稀有的尖叶水草。 迪文补充道：“这里有这种令人难以置信、非常罕见的野生动物，但实际上人们确实有可能看到它们，欣赏到美丽的景色，并真正体验布罗德兹的魔力。” “通过开发让野生动物感到安全、能够找到合适食物以及庇护和养家糊口的栖息地，多年来，团队创建了一个保护区，不仅帮助稀有物种生存，而且繁荣发展。” 她说，夏天的热浪“很猛烈”，但他们希望能有一个凉爽、湿润的秋天，让保护区做好应对洪水事件和季节性潮汐带来的“盐水激增”的准备。 斯特朗普肖正在举办各种活动来庆祝这一里程碑，包括周日在现场导游带领下散步。 该保护区最初是一片无人管理的沼泽地，并于 20 世纪 70 年代中期被皇家鸟类保护协会 (RSPB) 接管。 BBC Look East 摄像师肖恩·惠特摩尔 (Shaun Whitmore) 一直很喜欢斯特朗普肖·芬 (Strumpshaw Fen)，他用自己的话解释了原因。 除了担任 BBC 电视摄影师的工作之外，我一直对野生动物摄影很感兴趣，而斯特朗普肖 (Strumpshaw) 是沉迷于这种热情的完美场所。 除此之外，斯特朗普肖是我可以退后一步思考我的生活的地方。 2016年，那是我去过的地方，当时我生活中的一切都让我难以承受。大自然为我提供了一条摆脱当时崩溃的出路。 2019 年 12 月，我生​​日那天，我带着未来的妻子在斯特朗普肖芬 (Strumpshaw Fen) 求婚。 2020 年，我被要求制作一部关于我最喜欢的地方的电影，因为我因新冠病毒风险而处于隔离状态 - 我不得不选择斯特朗普肖芬！ 也许我的时机不对，因为拍摄两天后我们就进入了封锁状态。我确实拍了一部电影，并在接下来的一周在《Look East》上上映，展示了我们在不得不待在室内一段时间时所缺失的东西。 我对诺福克这个令人惊叹的地方有着美好的回忆，那里有芦苇床、牧场沼泽、林地和河滨，还有大量的鸟类和其他……

reflection.en: The 50th anniversary of the Strumpshaw Fen reserve is a testament to dedicated stewardship. It's a reminder that the natural world, in all its intricate biodiversity, reflects the profound wisdom and artistry of its Creator. May we continue to be faithful stewards of these precious ecosystems.
reflection.zh: 斯特拉普肖沼泽保护区成立50周年，是对忠实管理的有力证明。它提醒我们，大自然及其错综复杂的生物多样性，反映了其创造主的深邃智慧和艺术。愿我们继续忠实地管理这些宝贵的生态系统。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: A mysterious signal around Earth could be dark matter
title.zh: 地球周围的神秘信号可能是暗物质

summary.en: Scientists have utilized Earth's magnetic field and atmosphere as a planet-sized detector to investigate the lightest proposed forms of dark matter. This method has significantly improved limits on ultralight axions and revealed intriguing signals of dark photons that require further study.
summary.zh: 科学家利用地球的磁场和大气层作为行星大小的探测器，以寻找最轻的暗物质形式。这种方法大大提高了对超轻轴子的限制，并发现了几个有趣的暗光子信号，这些信号仍需进一步研究。

body.en:
Dark matter is one of the biggest unsolved mysteries in modern physics. Astronomers are highly confident that it exists and estimate that it accounts for about a quarter of the universe's total energy content, yet scientists still do not know what it is made of.

Two leading possibilities are hypothetical particles known as ultralight axions and dark photons . In the mass range examined by the researchers, these particles would be extraordinarily light, roughly 19 to 21 orders of magnitude lighter than an electron.

Many traditional axion experiments try to convert axions into photons by exposing them to extremely strong magnetic fields inside laboratories. The challenge is scale. Even powerful lab magnets can only cover a relatively small region.

Researchers from Kyoto University, Hiroshima University, and Nihon University saw a way around that limitation. Instead of relying only on laboratory equipment, they asked whether Earth's own magnetic environment could be used as part of the experiment.

"We asked ourselves whether we could use the Earth itself as a giant detector in the search," says corresponding author Atsushi Taruya. "The Earth-ionosphere cavity acts as a natural resonator that amplifies electromagnetic waves right around the mass range we wanted to probe."

The region between Earth's surface and the ionosphere can naturally resonate with electromagnetic waves, much like a large cavity. That made it especially useful for searching for signals associated with the ultralight particles the team wanted to investigate.

One obstacle was that previous theory could only reliably describe frequencies below 1 Hz. That left much of the potentially useful frequency range unexplored.

To solve this problem, the researchers developed a new theoretical framework that includes the electrical conductivity of the atmosphere. Their calculations showed that the Earth-ionosphere cavity can amplify signals near 8 Hz and allowed them to make reliable predictions up to about 30 Hz.

The model also predicted an important difference between the two dark matter candidates. Signals produced by axions should vary depending on location, with the strongest expected in Southeast Asia. Dark photon signals, by contrast, should appear at nearly the same strength around the world.

Using this framework, the team examined roughly 10 years of geomagnetic measurements collected between 2012 and 2022 by the British Geological Survey's Eskdalemuir Observatory.

The researchers first removed artificial sources of noise from the data. They then looked for the kind of steady signal concentrated within a very narrow frequency range that dark matter is expected to produce over long periods of time. The results were then subjected to statistical analysis.

The same theoretical...
body.zh: 暗物质是现代物理学中最大的未解之谜之一。天文学家对它的存在非常有信心，并估计它约占宇宙总能量的四分之一，但科学家仍然不知道它是由什么组成的。 两种主要的可能性是被称为超轻轴子和暗光子的假设粒子。在研究人员检查的质量范围内，这些粒子非常轻，大约比电子轻 19 到 21 个数量级。 许多传统的轴子实验试图通过将轴子暴露在实验室内极强的磁场中来将轴子转化为光子。挑战在于规模。即使是强大的实验室磁铁也只能覆盖相对较小的区域。 来自京都大学、广岛大学和日本大学的研究人员找到了解决这一限制的方法。他们并没有仅仅依赖实验室设备，而是询问是否可以使用地球自身的磁环境作为实验的一部分。 “我们问自己是否可以使用地球本身作为搜索中的巨型探测器，”通讯作者 Atsushi Taruya 说。 “地球电离层空腔充当天然谐振器，可以放大我们想要探测的质量范围附近的电磁波。” 地球表面和电离层之间的区域可以自然地与电磁波共振，就像一个大空腔。这使得它对于搜索与团队想要研究的超轻粒子相关的信号特别有用。 一个障碍是先前的理论只能可靠地描述 1 Hz 以下的频率。这使得许多潜在有用的频率范围未被探索。 为了解决这个问题，研究人员开发了一个新的理论框架，其中包括大气的电导率。他们的计算表明，地球电离层空腔可以放大接近 8 Hz 的信号，并使他们能够做出高达约 30 Hz 的可靠预测。 该模型还预测了两种暗物质候选者之间的重要差异。轴子产生的信号应该根据位置的不同而有所不同，预计东南亚的信号最强。相比之下，暗光子信号在世界各地应该以几乎相同的强度出现。 利用这个框架，研究小组检查了英国地质调查局埃斯克代尔缪尔天文台在 2012 年至 2022 年间收集的大约 10 年的地磁测量结果。 研究人员首先从数据中去除了人为噪声源。然后，他们寻找暗物质在很长一段时间内产生的集中在非常窄的频率范围内的稳定信号。然后对结果进行统计分析。 同样的理论...

reflection.en: The vastness of the universe and its many mysteries, like dark matter, invite us to explore and understand creation. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the sky, and they will tell you... In all these the hand of Yahweh has done this.' The scientific endeavor to uncover these secrets is a way of observing the...
reflection.zh: 宇宙的浩瀚及其诸多奥秘，如暗物质，邀请我们去探索和理解受造界。正如约伯书12:7-9所提醒的：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你……这一切都是雅伟的手所做的。” 科学界揭示这些秘密的努力，正是观察造物主精妙作为的一种方式。

title.en: 80,000-year-old “arrowheads” rewrite human history
title.zh: 8万年前的“箭头”改写人类历史

summary.en: Archaeologists have identified tiny 80,000-year-old projectile points in Uzbekistan that may have been used like arrowheads. Their size, design, and impact damage closely resemble weapons found much later at a Homo sapiens site in France. The discovery suggests sophisticated projectile technology may have appeared in...
summary.zh: 考古学家在乌兹别克斯坦发现了一些微小的、有8万年历史的投射点，它们可能被用作箭头。它们的尺寸、设计和撞击损伤与后来在法国的一个智人遗址发现的武器非常相似。这一发现表明，复杂的投射技术可能在中亚出现，远在现代人类在欧洲站稳脚跟之前，这可能会改写人类迁徙史上的一个重要篇章。

body.en: Archaeologists have identified tiny 80,000-year-old projectile points in Uzbekistan that may have been used like arrowheads. Their size, design, and impact damage closely resemble weapons found much later at a Homo sapiens site in France. The discovery suggests sophisticated projectile technology may have appeared in Central Asia long before modern humans became firmly established in Europe, potentially rewriting a major chapter of human migration.
body.zh: 考古学家在乌兹别克斯坦发现了具有 8 万年历史的微小射弹点，这些射弹点可能被用作箭头。它们的尺寸、设计和冲击损伤与很久以后在法国智人遗址发现的武器非常相似。这一发现表明，复杂的射弹技术可能早在现代人类在欧洲站稳脚跟之前就已经出现在中亚，这有可能改写人类迁徙的重要篇章。

reflection.en: The discovery of these ancient projectile points in Uzbekistan is a testament to the ingenuity that has characterized humanity throughout its history. It reminds us that wisdom and skill are not solely modern inventions, but have deep roots, observable even in the remnants of our earliest ancestors. As we uncover more about our past, we see the unfolding of...
reflection.zh: 在乌兹别克斯坦发现这些古老的投射点，证明了贯穿人类历史的创造力。它提醒我们，智慧和技能并非现代的发明，而是有着深厚的根源，即使在我们最早祖先的遗迹中也能观察到。随着我们对过去的了解越来越多，我们看到了雅伟创造的展开，以及祂赋予我们的非凡能力。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Aviation faces hotter, stormier skies – and passengers might have to accept more disruption
title.zh: 航空业面临更炎热、风暴更频繁的天空——乘客可能不得不接受更多延误和干扰

summary.en: Are people going to have to increasingly accept more delays and diversions as the effects of climate change intensify?
summary.zh: 随着气候变化的影响加剧，人们是否将不得不越来越多地接受更多的延误和改航？

body.en:
As the country sweltered through one of the many heatwaves of a baking summer in late June, towering thunderclouds were gathering over the south of England and across much of northern Europe. It was a Saturday, and with the holiday season getting under way, thousands of passengers were heading to London's Heathrow and Gatwick airports to catch flights abroad. It was always going to be a very busy day.

What followed, however, was chaos for travellers. As air traffic controllers struggled to route aircraft around the storms, airspace became heavily congested and many planes due to fly were simply forced to wait on the ground. In the end, some 900 flights to and from both airports were delayed, some by up to 11 hours. Dozens more were cancelled. At airports across Europe, passengers expecting to fly into London also faced long waits and uncertainty.

The weather in the UK may now have cooled, and passengers may soon forget their experiences. But some within the industry believe what happened in June should be seen as a warning.

The timing in this case was clearly unlucky. But there are concerns that such incidents are only going to become more common as the effects of climate change mount up around the world and weather systems are likely to become increasingly unstable, making disruption more likely and adding to costs for airlines, airports and travellers.

Tim Atkinson, an airline risk consultant and former pilot, says the very crowded skies over the UK and northern Europe mean the region is particularly exposed.

He thinks there is a real risk, for example, that all of London's airports could be affected by storms at the same time, potentially with major consequences in the air and on the ground.

"We're going from the kind of weather activity which takes out an airport, and which the system kind of copes with… to a situation where, with very little predictability, it would be possible to lose all of the London airports from real-time operation quite swiftly and with little notice".

Such a scenario, he thinks, would make the disruption for passengers caused by the incident in June seem relatively minor – and could even put lives at risk. But how likely is it?

For controllers at National Air Traffic Services's (NATS) main control centre in Swanwick, Hampshire, thunderstorms are a major preoccupation. When I visit, it is a hot and humid day, there are ominous dark clouds in the sky, and heavy, thundery downpours are hitting the surrounding region.

In Terminal Control, the part of the building responsible for flights heading to or from airports in London and southern England, those same storm cells are being monitored continuously. Their progress is tracked on large radar screens, while at the same time weather forecasts are carefully...
body.zh: 六月下旬，当这个国家经历了炎热夏季的众多热浪之一时，高耸的雷雨云正在英格兰南部和北欧大部分地区聚集。那是一个星期六，随着假期的到来，成千上万的乘客前往伦敦希思罗机场和盖特威克机场搭乘国外航班。这总是非常忙碌的一天。 然而，随之而来的是旅客的混乱。由于空中交通管制员努力引导飞机绕过风暴，空域变得严重拥堵，许多原定飞行的飞机被迫在地面等待。最终，大约 900 架次往返这两个机场的航班均被延误，有的延误长达 11 小时。还有数十个被取消。在欧洲各地的机场，预计飞往伦敦的乘客也面临着漫长的等待和不确定性。 英国的天气现在可能已经变冷，乘客可能很快就会忘记他们的经历。但一些业内人士认为，6月份发生的事情应该被视为一个警告。 这起案件的时机显然很不走运。但有人担心，随着气候变化的影响在世界各地加剧，天气系统可能变得越来越不稳定，此类事件只会变得更加普遍，从而更有可能造成干扰，并增加航空公司、机场和旅客的成本。 航空公司风险顾问兼前飞行员蒂姆·阿特金森表示，英国和北欧上空非常拥挤，意味着该地区尤其容易受到影响。 例如，他认为存在真正的风险，伦敦所有机场可能同时受到风暴影响，可能对空中和地面造成重大影响。 “我们正在从那种导致机场瘫痪、系统需要应对的天气活动转变为这样一种情况：在几乎没有可预测性的情况下，所有伦敦机场有可能在几乎没有通知的情况下很快就失去实时运行的能力”。 他认为，这种情况会使 6 月份的事件对乘客造成的干扰显得相对较小，甚至可能危及生命。但这种可能性有多大呢？ 对于位于汉普郡斯旺威克的国家空中交通服务 (NATS) 主控制中心的管制员来说，雷暴是他们最关心的问题。我去的时候，天气炎热潮湿，天空乌云密布，周围地区还​​下着倾盆大雨。 在航站楼控制中心（负责往返伦敦和英格兰南部机场的航班的大楼部分），这些风暴单元正在受到持续监控。他们的进展在大型雷达屏幕上被追踪，同时天气预报也被仔细地......

reflection.en: The recent chaos at Heathrow and Gatwick airports, with nearly 900 flights delayed due to severe thunderstorms, illustrates how climate change intensifies natural disruptions. As Psalm 46:1 reminds us, 'God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.' In times of unpredictable weather and travel chaos, this offers a perspective of divine...
reflection.zh: 近期在希思罗和盖特威克机场因严重雷暴天气导致近900个航班延误的混乱场面，说明了气候变化如何加剧了自然界的干扰。正如诗篇46:1所提醒我们的：“神是我们的避难所，是力量，是患难中随时的帮助。” 在不可预测的天气和旅行混乱时期，这提供了一种在地上动荡不安中，神同在和最终保障的视角。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Breaking through AlphaFold's limits to predict how proteins change shape
title.zh: 突破AlphaFold的局限性，预测蛋白质如何改变形状

summary.en: Conformational changes in proteins are vital to their function yet remain challenging for state-of-the-art artificial intelligence, such as AlphaFold3, to predict. Researchers at the Institute for Molecular Science (IMS), and the Graduate University for Advanced Studies, SOKENDAI introduced a repulsive force between...
summary.zh: 蛋白质的构象变化对其功能至关重要，但对于像AlphaFold3这样的最先进人工智能来说，预测这些变化仍然具有挑战性。分子科学研究所（IMS）和高等研究生院大学SOKENDAI的研究人员在预测结构之间引入了排斥力，使AlphaFold3能够采样其默认设置很少捕获的多种构象状态。

body.en: Conformational changes in proteins are vital to their function yet remain challenging for state-of-the-art artificial intelligence, such as AlphaFold3, to predict. Researchers at the Institute for Molecular Science (IMS), and the Graduate University for Advanced Studies, SOKENDAI introduced a repulsive force between predicted structures, allowing AlphaFold3 to sample the multiple conformational states that its default settings rarely capture.
body.zh: 蛋白质的构象变化对其功能至关重要，但对于 AlphaFold3 等最先进的人工智能来说，预测仍然具有挑战性。分子科学研究所 (IMS) 和高级研究大学 SOKENDAI 的研究人员在预测结构之间引入了排斥力，使 AlphaFold3 能够对默认设置很少捕获的多种构象状态进行采样。

reflection.en: The intricate dance of proteins, their ability to shift and change shape, is a marvel of biological engineering. Scientists, through dedicated research and innovative methods, are peeling back layers of this complexity. This pursuit of understanding the 'how' of life's machinery reflects a deep human impulse to explore the wonders of creation, finding...
reflection.zh: 蛋白质的复杂舞蹈，它们改变形状的能力，是生物工程的奇迹。科学家们通过专注的研究和创新的方法，正在揭开这种复杂性的层层面纱。这种对生命机制“如何运作”的理解追求，反映了人类探索造物之奇的深层冲动，并在其精密的构造中找到智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: How much clearcutting can nature sustain? A study determines the ecological limit for boreal forest birds
title.zh: 大片采伐对北方森林鸟类的影响有多大？一项研究确定了生态极限

summary.en: A study by the University of Jyväskylä in Finland has, for the first time, established an ecological threshold for the extent of clearcutting in boreal forests. The findings indicate that preserving bird species specialized in old-growth forests necessitates either an average forest rotation period of at least 90...
summary.zh: 一项由芬兰于韦斯屈莱大学牵头进行的研究，首次评估了北方森林采伐量的生态阈值。研究结果表明，要维持以原始森林为生的特有鸟类种群，平均需要至少90年的森林轮伐期，或者将约五分之一的森林面积排除在皆伐管理之外。该研究为森林的生态可持续利用提供了具体目标。

body.en: A study led by the University of Jyväskylä in Finland evaluated, for the first time, an ecological threshold for the amount of clearcutting in boreal forests. According to the results, maintaining populations of bird species specialized in old-growth forests requires either a forest rotation period of at least 90 years on average or that approximately one-fifth of the forest area be excluded from clearcut management. The study provides a concrete target for the ecologically sustainable use of forests.
body.zh: 芬兰于韦斯屈莱大学领导的一项研究首次评估了北方森林砍伐量的生态阈值。根据结果​​，维持专门生活在古老森林中的鸟类种群需要平均至少 90 年的森林轮作期，或者将大约五分之一的森林面积排除在砍伐管理之外。该研究为森林的生态可持续利用提供了具体目标。

reflection.en: The intricate balance of ecosystems, as explored in this study of boreal forests and their bird populations, reflects the profound wisdom woven into creation. The Psalmist marvels, 'How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.' This research helps us understand and respect the delicate systems Yahweh has...
reflection.zh: 这项关于北方森林及其鸟类种群的研究，揭示了生态系统的复杂平衡，这反映了雅伟编织进受造界的深邃智慧。诗人惊叹道：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！万物都凭你的智慧而造；全地充满了你的造物。”这项研究帮助我们理解并尊重雅伟所设立的精妙系统。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: FAST finds two mysterious hydrogen clouds with no visible stars
title.zh: FAST发现两团无可见恒星的神秘氢云

summary.en: Astronomers using China's FAST radio telescope have detected two large clouds of hydrogen gas near the Whirlpool galaxy. Each cloud contains approximately 3 million times the mass of the sun in hydrogen but lacks any detectable stars or optical counterparts, presenting a puzzle for current cosmological models.
summary.zh: 天文学家使用中国的FAST射电望远镜在旋涡星系附近探测到两团巨大的氢气云。每团云的氢气质量约为太阳的300万倍，但却没有任何可探测到的恒星或光学对应体，这给当前的宇宙学模型带来了谜团。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Astronomers have found two clouds of hydrogen near the Whirlpool galaxy that appear to contain almost no stars. The clouds, discovered with China's FAST radio telescope, each contain roughly 3 million times the mass of the sun in hydrogen but have no detectable optical counterpart. Their properties are outlined in a new paper published in the Astronomy & Astrophysics journal on Aug. 4.

According to the standard Lambda Cold Dark Matter (LCDM) model of the universe, structure forms hierarchically: Small dark-matter halos form first, then merge to build larger halos and galaxies. But not every dark-matter halo is expected to become a galaxy because several processes can suppress star formation at sufficiently low masses.

If a halo's gravitational potential is weak, stars may not form. If the gas is not dense and cold enough, it cannot collapse into stars. Gas may be heated by the ultraviolet (UV) background, which is made up of diffuse radiation from quasars and stars throughout the universe. This leads to a population of dark-matter halos containing neutral hydrogen gas but few or no stars.

In this work, led by Qingze Chen of the National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences, researchers tested this idea: a small dark-matter halo that retained some gas after cosmic reionization but whose gas never became cold and dense enough to form stars because it was heated by UV radiation. They call it the reionization-limited H I cloud, or RELHIC.

To be classified as a RELHIC, a surviving hydrogen cloud should be compact, roughly spherical, show narrow spectral lines with velocities around 20 kilometers per second (km/s), and have no stellar component detected at optical wavelengths. LCDM predicts a huge population of low-mass dark-matter halos. So far, only a handful of such starless clouds have been identified.

The researchers searched for 21-cm radio wavelength signals—telltale signatures of neutral hydrogen (H I). They used H I observations from the Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope (FAST), specifically the FEASTS survey.

They analyzed 55 galaxies in the FEASTS sample to identify objects meeting the conditions for hydrogen clouds. Only two objects—Cloud N and Cloud S—in the entire sample passed the criteria.

Both have a hydrogen mass of roughly 3 million solar masses and a total halo mass of 3.7 billion solar masses. This large ratio between gas mass and total halo mass closely matches theoretical predictions for such systems. "They are both compatible with the RELHIC framework," the team writes in the paper.

Interestingly, both lie around...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 天文学家在漩涡星系附近发现了两片氢云，它们似乎几乎不包含恒星。这些云是用中国的FAST射电望远镜发现的，每个云中都含有质量约为太阳300万倍的氢，但没有可探测到的光学对应物。 8 月 4 日发表在《天文学与天体物理学》杂志上的一篇新论文概述了它们的特性。 根据宇宙的标准 Lambda 冷暗物质 (LCDM) 模型，结构是分层形成的：首先形成小型暗物质晕，然后合并形成更大的晕和星系。但并不是每个暗物质晕都有望成为星系，因为有几个过程可以抑制质量足够低的恒星形成。 如果光环的引力势弱，恒星可能不会形成。如果气体密度不够、温度不够，就无法塌缩成恒星。气体可能会被紫外线（UV）背景加热，紫外线背景由来自整个宇宙的类星体和恒星的漫射辐射组成。这导致了暗物质晕的聚集，其中含有中性氢气，但很少或没有恒星。 在中国科学院国家天文台陈庆泽领导的这项工作中，研究人员测试了这个想法：一个小型暗物质晕在宇宙再电离后保留了一些气体，但其气体永远不会变得足够冷和稠密以形成恒星，因为它被紫外线辐射加热。他们称之为再电离限制 H I 云，或 RELHIC。 要被归类为 RELHIC，幸存的氢云应该是致密的，大致呈球形，显示出狭窄的光谱线，速度约为每秒 20 公里 (km/s)，并且在光学波长下没有检测到恒星成分。 LCDM 预测存在大量低质量暗物质晕。到目前为止，只有少数这样的无星云被识别出来。 研究人员寻找 21 厘米无线电波长信号——中性氢 (H I) 的明显特征。他们使用了 500 米孔径球面望远镜 (FAST) 的 H I 观测结果，特别是 FEASTS 巡天观测。 他们分析了 FEASTS 样本中的 55 个星系，以确定满足氢云条件的天体。整个样本中只有两个物体——云 N 和云 S——通过了标准。 两者的氢质量约为 300 万太阳质量，晕总质量为 37 亿太阳质量。气体质量与晕环总质量之间的巨大比率与此类系统的理论预测非常吻合。 “它们都与 RELHIC 框架兼容，”该团队在论文中写道。 有趣的是，两者都躺在...

reflection.en: The discovery of these immense, starless hydrogen clouds challenges our understanding of cosmic structure. It reminds us that the universe holds profound mysteries, vast beyond our current comprehension. Like the psalmist, we can look to the heavens and be filled with awe at the sheer scale and intricate design of creation, recognizing that Yahweh's glory...
reflection.zh: 发现这些巨大的、无恒星的氢云挑战了我们对宇宙结构的理解。它提醒我们，宇宙充满了我们目前无法完全理解的深邃奥秘。就像诗篇作者一样，我们可以仰望星空，对创造的浩瀚规模和精妙设计感到敬畏，并认识到雅伟的荣耀在寂静的宇宙中得以彰显。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Views from a physician and veterinarian: How to improve barriers to pet care when owners are hospitalized
title.zh: 来自医生和兽医的观点：如何改善主人住院期间的宠物护理障碍

summary.en: The human-animal bond is often so strong that pet owners may delay or forgo medical treatment or leave a health care facility against medical advice if they have no one to care for their pet at home. A perspective paper published in the New England Journal of Medicine explains why pet owners may need different...
summary.zh: 人类与动物之间的纽带常常非常牢固，以至于宠物主人可能会推迟或放弃医疗治疗，或者在无人照看家中宠物的情况下违背医嘱离开医疗机构。发表在《新英格兰医学杂志》上的一篇观点文章解释了为什么宠物主人在住院时可能需要不同的护理方法，这是来自埃默里大学一位医生和俄亥俄州立大学一位兽医的观点。

body.en: The human-animal bond is often so strong that pet owners may delay or forgo medical treatment or leave a health care facility against medical advice if they have no one to care for their pet at home. A perspective paper published in the New England Journal of Medicine explains why pet owners may need different approaches to care when hospitalized, according to an Emory University physician and an Ohio State University veterinarian.
body.zh: 人与动物之间的联系往往非常牢固，以至于宠物主人如果家里没有人照顾宠物，可能会推迟或放弃治疗，或者不顾医疗建议离开医疗机构。埃默里大学的一名医生和俄亥俄州立大学的一名兽医表示，《新英格兰医学杂志》上发表的一篇观点论文解释了为什么宠物主人在住院时可能需要不同的护理方法。

reflection.en: The deep connection between people and their pets can create difficult choices during a health crisis. This situation calls for compassion and practical solutions, reminding us to speak up for those whose well-being is tied to the care of another, especially when they are unable to advocate for themselves.
reflection.zh: 人与宠物之间深厚的联系在健康危机期间会带来艰难的选择。这种情况需要同情心和实际的解决方案，提醒我们要为那些福祉与照顾他人息息相关的人发声，尤其是在他们无法为自己辩护的时候。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Flourishing green communities are changing lives
title.zh: 蓬勃发展的绿色社区正在改变生活

summary.en: Four projects have been nominated in the environmental category in Devon's Make a Difference Awards for their work in making communities more eco-friendly, wilder, and healthier through activities like planting trees, growing vegetables, and leading nature exploration.
summary.zh: 在德文郡的“做出改变奖”环保类别中，有四个项目因其在使社区更环保、更野性、更健康方面所做的工作而获得提名，这些项目通过植树、种植蔬菜和组织自然探索等活动来达成目标。

body.en:
Four projects have been nominated in the environmental category in BBC Radio Devon's Make a Difference Awards.

The Growing Well Garden in Bow, the Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens in mid-Devon, Shallowford Farm on Dartmoor, and Sustainable Hatherleigh are being recognised for making their communities more eco-friendly, wilder and healthier.

They are doing this in a range of ways from planting trees and growing vegetables, to leading bug hunts and rediscovering nature.

The winners of the Make a Difference awards are due to be announced on 24 September at Buckfast Abbey.

Growing Well Garden is part of a green social prescribing project, where gardening is used as a therapeutic tool and helps a doctor connect with her patients in a different way.

Dr Susan Taheri is an NHS GP at Bow Medical Practice and the founder of Growing Well Garden project - she said the scheme reignited her passion for being a GP.

She said meeting patients in a garden can have benefits compared to seeing them a consulting room and describes the garden as her "happy place".

"There's a lot more getting your hands dirty and not worrying too much about germs," she said.

Retired horticulturalist Charles Staniland's love for the outdoors started in early childhood and he now volunteers there, teaching young people to get their hands dirty.

He said he wanted to show a more physical approach to food, that it doesn't just show up on a plate, and that it's something they can contribute to.

Staniland hopes the project can "encourage a new generation to understand and value the world around them".

"It takes people out of a concrete environment - it's a very good first step into a greener environment," he said.

Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens are an independent, environmentally-focused, volunteer based group which takes care of the parish's greenery.

For Pete Drew and the other wardens, looking after the environment is a community effort, often powered by cake.

The group plants, protects and maintains trees and hedges on publicly owned land, working with councils and landowners.

He said it was about "taking pride in where you live and making local spaces better for everyone".

Sustainable Hatherleigh runs a range of projects to support the community, from leading bug hunts and encouraging wildflowers and biodiversity in the local graveyard to community composting and running a repair café.

Their site in the middle of the town has now been recognised as a county wildlife site.

Jo Pullin and Sustainable Hatherleigh hope to create a resilient future for the area.

Jo Pullin from Sustainable Hatherleigh, Dr Susan Taheri from Growing Well Garden, Charles Staniland from Shallowford Farm and Pete Drew from Sampford Tree Wardens are finalists in the awards.

Follow BBC Devon on X ,...
body.zh: 四个项目已获得 BBC 德文郡电台“Make a Difference Awards”环境类别提名。 Bow 的 Growing Well Garden、德文郡中部的 Sampford Peverell Tree Wardens、Dartmoor 的 Shallowford Farm 和 Sustainable Hatherleigh 因使社区变得更加环保、更加狂野和健康而受到认可。 他们通过多种方式做到这一点，从植树和种植蔬菜，到领导昆虫狩猎和重新发现自然。 Make a Difference 奖的获奖者将于 9 月 24 日在巴克法斯特修道院公布。 Growing Well Garden 是绿色社会处方项目的一部分，其中园艺被用作治疗工具，帮助医生以不同的方式与患者建立联系。 Susan Taheri 博士是 Bow Medical Practice 的 NHS 全科医生，也是 Growing Well Garden 项目的创始人 - 她说该计划重新点燃了她成为全科医生的热情。 她说，与在咨询室见到病人相比，在花园里会见病人更有好处，并将花园描述为她的“快乐的地方”。 “还有很多事情会弄脏你的双手，而且不用太担心细菌，”她说。 退休园艺家查尔斯·斯坦尼兰 (Charles Staniland) 从童年时期就开始热爱户外活动，现在他在那里做志愿者，教导年轻人要亲自动手。 他说他想展示一种更实际的食物处理方式，食物不仅仅出现在盘子上，而且这是他们可以做出的贡献。 斯坦尼兰希望该项目能够“鼓励新一代了解和重视他们周围的世界”。 “它让人们脱离了具体的环境——这是迈向绿色环境的非常好的第一步，”他说。 Sampford Peverell 树木管理员是一个独立、注重环保、以志愿者为基础的团体，负责照顾教区的绿化。 对于皮特·德鲁和其他狱长来说，保护环境是一项社区努力，通常由蛋糕提供动力。 该组织与议会和土地所有者合作，在公有土地上种植、保护和维护树木和树篱。 他说这是为了“为自己居住的地方感到自豪，并让当地空间对每个人来说都变得更好”。 可持续哈瑟利开展了一系列项目来支持社区，从领导昆虫狩猎、鼓励当地墓地种植野花和生物多样性，到社区堆肥和经营修理咖啡馆。 他们位于镇中心的地点现已被认定为县野生动物保护区。 乔·普林 (Jo Pullin) 和可持续哈瑟利 (Sustainable Hatherleigh) 希望为该地区创造一个充满活力的未来。 来自 Sustainable Hatherleigh 的 Jo Pullin、来自 Growing Well Garden 的 Susan Taheri 博士、来自 Shallowford Farm 的 Charles Staniland 和来自 Sampford Tree Wardens 的 Pete Drew 入围该奖项。 在 X 上关注 BBC Devon，...

reflection.en: The nomination of these four projects in Devon celebrates the tangible impact of community-led environmental initiatives. It echoes the Genesis account where Yahweh surveyed all that was made and declared it 'very good.' These efforts remind us that tending to the earth, growing food, and fostering wild spaces are acts that honor this original goodness.
reflection.zh: 德文郡这四个项目的提名，是对社区主导的环境倡议所产生的切实影响的庆祝。这呼应了《创世记》中雅伟审视他所造的一切，并宣告其“甚好”的记载。这些努力提醒我们，照料大地、种植食物和培育野外空间，都是荣耀这最初美善之举。

verse.textEn: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
verse.textZh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。

title.en: Alcohol-related cancer deaths in US have more than doubled over three decades
title.zh: 美国酒精相关癌症死亡人数三十年翻倍

summary.en: A study reveals that alcohol-related cancer deaths in the US have more than doubled over the past three decades, with research indicating that even one drink per day can increase cancer risk, extending beyond liver cancer.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，美国与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数在过去三十年里翻了一番多。研究表明，即使每天只饮用一杯酒也会增加患癌症的风险，并且这种影响已超出肝癌的范畴。

body.en: Study finds just one drink per day could raise risk of disease with impacts extending far beyond liver cancer Alcohol-related cancer deaths in the US have more than doubled over three decades, with new research showing that just one drink per day could raise cancer risk and that the impacts extend far beyond liver cancer. Researchers at Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center, part of the University of Miami Miller School of Medicine, analyzed more than three decades of Global Burden of Disease data. Their study, published in August in the Lancet Regional Health , found that annual cancer deaths attributed to alcohol climbed from 11,361 in 1990 to 23,126 in 2023. Continue reading...
body.zh: 研究发现，每天只喝一杯酒就会增加患癌症的风险，其影响远远超出肝癌范围。三十年来，美国与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数增加了一倍多，新的研究表明，每天只喝一杯酒就可能增加癌症风险，其影响范围远远超出肝癌范围。迈阿密大学米勒医学院下属的西尔维斯特综合癌症中心的研究人员分析了三十多年来的全球疾病负担数据。他们的研究发表在 8 月份的《柳叶刀地区健康》杂志上，发现每年因酒精导致的癌症死亡人数从 1990 年的 11,361 人攀升至 2023 年的 23,126 人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report from the US paints a sobering picture of how lifestyle choices can have profound and escalating health consequences. The doubling of alcohol-related cancer deaths over thirty years is a stark reminder of the pervasive impact of disease and the need for awareness and care. As James 5:14 encourages prayer for the sick, it also calls us to consider...
reflection.zh: 这份来自美国的研究描绘了一幅令人警醒的画面，揭示了生活方式的选择如何会带来深远且不断升级的健康后果。三十年来，与酒精相关的癌症死亡人数翻倍，这鲜明地提醒我们疾病的普遍影响，以及提高认识和关怀的必要性。正如雅各书5:14鼓励为病人祷告一样，它也促使我们反思那些可预防的痛苦根源，并在日常习惯中寻求智慧。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Milky Way at the dining table: Bath art show celebrates 18th-century brother and sister astronomers
title.zh: 巴斯展览突出姊妹发现——以及英格兰首位有薪女天文学家

summary.en: An exhibition in Bath showcases artworks in a Georgian townhouse where siblings William and Caroline Herschel lived and conducted groundbreaking astronomical research in the late 18th century, celebrating their pioneering spirit.
summary.zh: 在巴斯的一处乔治亚风格联排别墅中，一项新的艺术展览展示了威廉和卡罗琳·赫歇尔兄妹的生活和工作。这对兄妹在18世纪末在这里进行了一系列非凡的天文发现，展览突出了他们开创性的精神。

body.en: Exhibition opens in former home of William Herschel, who discovered Uranus, and his comet-spotting sibling Caroline From the garden of their Georgian townhouse in Bath in the late 18th century, a brother and sister made a series of extraordinary astronomical discoveries. A new art show in the house where the siblings – William and Caroline Herschel – worked and lived highlights their pioneering spirit and their domestic arrangements. Continue reading...
body.zh: 展览展出了威廉·赫歇尔 (William Herschel) 和卡罗琳·赫歇尔 (Caroline Herschel) 在 18 世纪末工作和生活的联排别墅中的艺术品。 18 世纪末，一对兄妹在巴斯 (Bath) 乔治亚风格联排别墅的花园里做出了一系列非凡的天文发现。威廉·赫歇尔和卡罗琳·赫歇尔兄妹工作和生活的房子里举办了一场新的艺术展，凸显了他们的开拓精神和家庭安排。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The exhibition in Bath celebrates the remarkable astronomical work of William and Caroline Herschel. Their dedication to their craft, carried out in their home, reminds us that all honest labor, whether in science or art, can be a form of service. Colossians 3:23 calls us to do everything with our whole heart, as if working for Yahweh Himself, bringing a...
reflection.zh: 巴斯的展览颂扬了威廉和卡罗琳·赫歇尔兄妹非凡的天文工作。他们在家中对技艺的专注，提醒我们所有诚实的工作，无论是在科学还是艺术领域，都可以是一种服务。歌罗西书3:23呼吁我们凡事都从心里做，像是为主做的，为主而做，为人的努力带来了神圣的尊严。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Week in wildlife: a hitchhiking crab, a shy wallaby and penguins in little jackets
title.zh: 本周野生动物：搭便车的螃蟹、害羞的袋鼠和穿小外套的企鹅

summary.en: This week’s best wildlife photographs from around the world.
summary.zh: 本周来自世界各地的最佳野生动物照片。

reflection.en: The sheer variety and ingenuity of life on Earth, from a crab hitchhiking on a sea turtle to penguins sporting tiny jackets, points to a Creator of immense wisdom and artistry. These glimpses of the natural world invite us to marvel at the Creator's invisible attributes, made evident through the wonders of creation.
reflection.zh: 地球上生命的奇妙多样性和创造力，从搭便车的螃蟹到穿着小外套的企鹅，都指向一位拥有无穷智慧和艺术的创造者。这些对自然世界的瞥见，邀请我们惊叹于创造者那藉着受造之物而显明的、那看不见的属性。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: New Zealand drugs regulator approves use of MDMA to treat severe PTSD
title.zh: 新西兰药品监管机构批准使用MDMA治疗严重创伤后应激障碍

summary.en: New Zealand's pharmaceutical regulatory body, Medsafe, has approved the prescription of pharmaceutical-grade MDMA by two psychiatrists for individuals suffering from severe post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). This decision makes New Zealand the second country globally, after Australia in 2023, to authorize the use...
summary.zh: 新西兰药品监管机构Medsafe已批准两名精神科医生使用药用级MDMA为患有严重创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）的患者进行处方治疗。此举使新西兰成为继澳大利亚（2023年）之后，全球第二个批准使用迷幻剂治疗PTSD和难治性抑郁症的国家。

body.en: New Zealand decision follows Australian approval in 2023 of psychedelics to treat PTSD and treatment-resistant depression Two psychiatrists in New Zealand won approval on Friday to prescribe pharmaceutical-grade MDMA to people with severe post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). The move by New Zealand’s pharmaceutical regulatory body Medsafe makes the country only the second worldwide to approve the party drug for use in treating PTSD, following Australia in 2023. Continue reading...
body.zh: 继澳大利亚于 2023 年批准迷幻药用于治疗 PTSD 和难治性抑郁症之后，新西兰做出了这一决定。新西兰的两名精神科医生周五获得批准，可以为患有严重创伤后应激障碍 (PTSD) 的患者开出药用级 MDMA。新西兰药品监管机构 Medsafe 的此举使该国成为全球第二个批准该派对药物用于治疗 PTSD 的国家，继澳大利亚之后于 2023 年批准。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news from New Zealand offers a glimmer of hope for those grappling with the profound distress of severe PTSD. The approval of MDMA-assisted therapy signifies a step towards restoring minds deeply wounded by trauma, reflecting a journey from profound suffering towards healing and wholeness. May this new avenue bring peace and recovery to many.
reflection.zh: 新西兰的这项消息为那些饱受严重PTSD困扰的人们带来了一线希望。批准MDMA辅助疗法标志着朝着治愈创伤所致的深重心灵迈出了重要一步，这反映了一条从深重痛苦走向康复与健全的道路。愿这条新途径能为许多人带来平安与康复。

verse.textEn: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
verse.textZh: 他们来到耶稣那里，看见那被鬼附着的人，就是从前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心里明白过来，他们就害怕。

title.en: ‘They’ll be finding bodies next year’: a renowned forensic scientist on Nepal’s ‘extreme challenges’
title.zh: “明年他们会找到尸体”：一位著名的法医谈尼泊尔的“极端挑战”

summary.en: A world-renowned forensic scientist, Prof Richard Bassed, who helped identify victims of the 2004 Boxing Day tsunami and the 2009 Black Saturday bushfires, stated that bodies from the Nepal-Tibet flood disaster may never be found or identified. He described the 'randomness of this massive flood' as particularly...
summary.zh: 一位世界知名的法医，曾协助辨认2004年节礼日海啸和2009年黑色星期六丛林大火的遇难者，理查德·巴塞德教授表示，尼泊尔-西藏洪水灾难中的遇难者遗体可能永远找不到，也可能永远无法辨认。他形容“这场巨大洪水的随机性”尤其令人心痛。

body.en: Prof Richard Bassed helped identify Boxing Day tsunami and victims of Australia’s catastrophic Black Saturday bushfires. ‘The randomness of this massive flood,’ he says. ‘That gets to you’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The bodies of some of those killed in the Nepal-Tibet flood disaster may never be found, and some of those that are may never be identified, a world-renowned forensic scientist says. Prof Richard Bassed, the head of forensic medicine at Melbourne’s Monash University, spent three months in Thailand after the 2004 Boxing Day tsunami and also helped to identify victims of Victoria’s catastrophic Black Saturday bushfires in 2009. Continue reading...
body.zh: 理查德·贝塞德教授帮助识别了节礼日海啸和澳大利亚灾难性黑色星期六丛林大火的受害者。 “这场大洪水的随机性，”他说。一位世界著名的法医科学家表示，在尼泊尔-西藏洪灾中丧生的一些人的尸体可能永远不会被发现，而其中一些人的身份可能永远不会被确认。墨尔本莫纳什大学法医学系主任理查德·巴塞德教授在 2004 年节礼日海啸后在泰国呆了三个月，还帮助识别了 2009 年维多利亚州灾难性黑色星期六森林大火的受害者。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The devastating flood in Nepal and Tibet has brought immense grief, with the possibility that many victims will never be recovered or identified. This profound loss echoes the human experience of suffering and mortality. Yet, the Scriptures offer a vision of ultimate hope, promising a time when 'he will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and death shall...
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏的毁灭性洪水带来了巨大的悲痛，许多遇难者可能永远无法被找回或辨认。这种深切的失落呼应了人类的苦难和死亡经历。然而，圣经提供了一个终极的希望愿景，承诺一个“神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭嚎、疼痛，因为以前的事都过去了”的时代。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Technology Desk
title.zh: 科技前沿

strap.en: Technology shaping how we live, work, and think.
strap.zh: 正在改变生活、工作与思考方式的科技动态。

title.en: Alarming AI ads are flooding social media in the lead-up to Victoria’s election. But who is behind them?
title.zh: 维多利亚州大选前夕，人工智能生成的虚假广告充斥社交媒体。但幕后黑手是谁？

summary.en: AI-generated advertisements featuring violent imagery and echoing opposition talking points are being used in Victoria's election campaign, outspending major parties. The origin of these ads remains unclear, raising concerns about their influence on the election.
summary.zh: 在维多利亚州大选前夕，人工智能生成的广告充斥社交媒体，这些广告包含暴力画面并呼应反对派的论调，其花费甚至超过了主要政党。这些广告的来源尚不清楚，引发了对其影响选举的担忧。

body.en: A machete-wielding robber, a ‘tsunami of debt’ … campaigns echoing opposition talking points outspend major parties Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A man clad in a balaclava and brandishing a machete terrorises a worker at a petrol station before firebombing the building on the way out. A woman gives birth on the side of the road, unable to reach a hospital due to ambulance ramping and crater-like potholes, which also stop a fire truck in its tracks. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一名挥舞砍刀的强盗，一场“债务海啸”……呼应反对派谈话要点的竞选活动比主要政党花费更多。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 一名身穿巴拉克拉法帽、挥舞着砍刀的男子恐吓加油站的一名工人，然后在离开时向大楼投掷燃烧弹。一名妇女在路边分娩，由于救护车坡道和火山口般的坑洼而无法到达医院，这也导致一辆消防车停在了路上。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence becomes more sophisticated, its capacity to generate convincing but false narratives grows. The use of such technology in political campaigns, as seen with the alarming AI ads in Victoria, challenges us to discern truth and resist deception. We are called to speak truthfully, for dishonesty erodes trust and harms the common good.
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能日益精进，其生成逼真但虚假叙事的能力也在增强。如维多利亚州令人担忧的人工智能广告所示，此类技术被用于政治竞选，这促使我们辨别真理并抵制欺骗。我们被呼召要说诚实话，因为不诚实会侵蚀信任并损害共同利益。

verse.textEn: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to your neighbor.
verse.textZh: 所以你们要弃绝谎言，各人与邻舍说实话。

title.en: Tesla’s Cybercab has been deployed, and it’s already under investigation
title.zh: 特斯拉的Cybercab已部署，并已接受调查

summary.en: The US government is investigating whether Tesla's Cybercab, a two-seater vehicle without traditional controls, meets federal safety standards as it begins public deployment in Texas and Florida.
summary.zh: 美国政府正在调查特斯拉的Cybercab是否符合联邦安全标准。这款没有传统控制装置的双座汽车已开始在德克萨斯州和佛罗里达州向公众开放。

body.en: Tesla’s Cybercab, a distinctive two-seater without a steering wheel or brake pedals, is set to start picking up members of the public in two states. But the vehicle is already under investigation by the US federal government, which is probing whether it meets federal safety standards. The investigation comes just hours after the electric automaker welcomed hundreds of fans to downtown Austin to ride in the driverless Cybercabs. Tesla plans to deploy the vehicles on its Robotaxi ride-hail network , which is currently operating in a handful of cities in Texas and Florida. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration is updating vehicle standards to make it easier and faster for driverless cars to deploy on public roads. It’s currently tweaking eight rules, including those requiring car parts that driverless cars don’t really need: brake pedals, windshield wipers, and rearview mirrors. But for now, years-old standards remain in place. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 特斯拉的 Cyber​​cab 是一款独特的双座车，没有方向盘或制动踏板，将开始在两个州搭载公众。但该车已经接受美国联邦政府的调查，调查其是否符合联邦安全标准。调查是在这家电动汽车制造商欢迎数百名粉丝来到奥斯汀市中心乘坐无人驾驶出租车几个小时后进行的。特斯拉计划将这些车辆部署在其 Robotaxi 网约车网络上，该网络目前在德克萨斯州和佛罗里达州的少数城市运营。美国国家公路交通安全管理局正在更新车辆标准，以使无人驾驶汽车更容易、更快速地在公共道路上部署。目前正在调整八项规则，包括那些需要无人驾驶汽车并不真正需要的汽车零部件的规则：制动踏板、挡风玻璃雨刷和后视镜。但目前，多年来的标准仍然存在。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: New technologies often arrive with great fanfare, promising innovation and convenience. However, as seen with Tesla's Cybercab, the true test lies not just in their initial reception but in their ability to meet fundamental safety and ethical standards. The scrutiny by the US government reminds us that progress must be tempered with caution and...
reflection.zh: 新技术常常伴随着盛大的宣传，承诺创新和便利。然而，正如特斯拉的Cybercab所见，真正的考验不仅在于其初步的接受程度，还在于其是否能达到基本的安全和伦理标准。美国政府的审查提醒我们，进步必须以谨慎和责任为度，确保技术进步服务于人类福祉，而不是损害它。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Cut the cameras: Flock surveillance cameras spur rare bipartisan backlash
title.zh: 切断摄像头：Flock监控摄像头引发罕见的跨党派强烈反对

summary.en: Politicians from both the right and left are opposing Flock surveillance cameras, as more Americans express disapproval of the technology. This rare bipartisan pushback against Flock Safety cameras is similar to widespread public anger over the construction of data centers that power artificial intelligence, with...
summary.zh: 来自左右两翼的政界人士正在反对Flock监控摄像头，同时越来越多的美国人对这项技术表示不满。这种罕见的跨党派反对Flock Safety摄像头的举动，与公众对为人工智能提供动力的、正在建设中的数据中心的普遍愤怒相似，民意调查显示约75%的美国人反对在其所在地区新建数据中心。

body.en: Politicians on the right and left are pushing back against Flock as more Americans voice opposition to the tech Growing factions from both sides of the political aisle in the US are pushing back against surveillance cameras made by a single company, a rare response in a sharply divided country with a president pushing an unwaveringly pro-tech agenda. The bipartisan backlash against Flock Safety cameras resembles nationwide rage toward the construction of large datacenters that power artificial intelligence. Polling shows roughly 75% of Americans oppose new datacenter construction in their areas. Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着越来越多的美国人表达对科技的反对，左右翼政客都在抵制弗洛克美国政治两派不断壮大的派系正在抵制一家公司制造的监控摄像头，这在一个总统坚定不移地推动支持科技议程的严重分裂的国家中是罕见的反应。两党对羊群安全摄像头的强烈反对，就像全国范围内对建设支持人工智能的大型数据中心的愤怒一样。民意调查显示，大约 75% 的美国人反对在他们所在地区建设新的数据中心。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The growing opposition to surveillance technologies like Flock cameras and AI data centers highlights a deep-seated concern about unseen powers and potential overreach. Ephesians 6:12 reminds us that our struggles are not merely against visible entities but also against underlying spiritual forces of control and manipulation. As we navigate the complexities...
reflection.zh: 对Flock摄像头和人工智能数据中心等监控技术日益增长的反对声音，凸显了人们对看不见的力量和潜在的过度扩张的深层担忧。以弗所书6:12提醒我们，我们的争战不仅是与属血气的争战，更是与那些属灵气的恶魔争战。当我们应对现代技术的复杂性时，保持辨别力和坚守真理至关重要，要认识到真正的自由和安全存在于比技术进步更高的原则之中。

verse.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verse.textZh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。

title.en: ‘We’re plausibly close to crossing the line’: are warnings of uncontrollable AI coming true?
title.zh: “我们可能已接近越过那条线”：关于无法控制的人工智能的警告正在成真吗？

summary.en: A series of significant safety incidents have amplified concerns regarding the power and inscrutability of the most advanced AI models. Analogies used by an AI governance expert depict humanity at a critical juncture, akin to early nuclear physicists before their first chain reaction, facing both peril and potential.
summary.zh: 一系列严重的事故加剧了人们对最先进人工智能模型的力量和不可穿透性的担忧。一位人工智能治理专家的类比描绘了人类正处于一个危险但充满潜力的时刻，类似于早期核物理学家在首次链式反应之前的情景。

body.en: A spate of serious safety incidents have increased fears about the power and impenetrability of the most advanced models Picture humanity in a boat being swept down a raging river, praying there is no Niagara Falls ahead. Or imagine standing with the pioneering physicists in 1942 before they triggered the first self-sustaining nuclear fission chain reaction beneath a Chicago stadium. These were two of the analogies used this week by Prof Robert Trager, an expert in the nascent field of AI governance, to describe the perilous but potential-filled moment the world stands at with accelerating artificial intelligence. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一连串严重的安全事件增加了人们对最先进模型的力量和不可穿透性的担忧。想象一下，人类乘坐一艘船被冲进汹涌的河流，祈祷前面没有尼亚加拉大瀑布。或者想象一下 1942 年，在物理学家先驱们在芝加哥体育场下方引发第一个自持核裂变链式反应之前，您与他们站在一起。这是人工智能治理新兴领域的专家罗伯特·特拉格教授本周使用的两个类比，用来描述世界正面临人工智能加速发展的危险但充满潜力的时刻。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, described as a boat swept towards an unknown precipice, evokes the ancient story of Babel. Humanity's ambition to build towers reaching the heavens, without sufficient wisdom or humility, can lead to unforeseen consequences. We are called to pursue knowledge and innovation, but always with a sober awareness of our limits and a...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，被比作一艘驶向未知深渊的船，令人联想到古代巴别塔的故事。人类渴望建造通天高塔的雄心，若缺乏足够的智慧和谦卑，可能导致无法预料的后果。我们被呼召去追求知识和创新，但必须时刻警醒于自身的局限，并深深依赖于神的指引。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Food delivery riders call on platforms to open up AI ‘black box’ they say has cut pay
title.zh: 外卖骑手呼吁平台公开AI“黑箱”，称其已削减工资

summary.en: Workers who blame algorithms for lowering their earnings are getting help from academics to find out how the system works. Gig economy workers are urging delivery platforms to open up the “black box” of computer-driven algorithms that determine the jobs they are offered and how much they are paid, blaming increased...
summary.zh: 工人们指责算法降低了他们的收入，并正在寻求学者的帮助来了解该系统的工作原理。零工经济工人敦促外卖平台公开决定他们获得工作机会以及报酬的计算机驱动算法的“黑箱”，并将工资降低归咎于人工智能使用量的增加。爱丁堡的一群外卖骑手表示，在Deliveroo、Uber Eats和Just...

body.en: Workers who blame algorithms for lowering their earnings are getting help from academics to find out how the system works Gig economy workers are urging delivery platforms to open up the “black box” of computer-driven algorithms that determine the jobs they are offered and how much they are paid, blaming increased use of AI for lowering wages. A group of food delivery riders in Edinburgh say their rates of pay have fallen and their working conditions have deteriorated at the same time as Deliveroo, Uber Eats and Just Eat, the three dominant gig economy platforms in the UK and Ireland, have increased their use of automation. Continue reading...
body.zh: 那些指责算法降低了收入的工人正在寻求学术界的帮助，以了解该系统是如何运作的。零工经济工人正在敦促交付平台打开计算机驱动算法的“黑匣子”，这些算法决定了他们提供的工作和报酬，他们将降低工资归咎于人工智能的使用增加。爱丁堡的一群送餐骑手表示，在英国和爱尔兰三大主要零工经济平台 Deliveroo、Uber Eats 和 Just Eat 增加自动化使用的同时，他们的工资下降了，工作条件也恶化了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of efficiency through AI can sometimes obscure the human cost. When algorithms dictate pay and working conditions, workers feel unheard and unfairly treated, as these food delivery riders in Edinburgh describe. The Bible speaks directly to this, with James warning that the cries of the unpaid or underpaid workers ascend to heaven.
reflection.zh: 通过人工智能追求效率有时会掩盖其对人类造成的代价。当算法决定薪酬和工作条件时，工人会感到被忽视和不公平对待，正如爱丁堡的外卖骑手们所描述的那样。圣经直接谈到了这一点，雅各书警告说，被拖欠或支付不足的工人的哀求会直达天上。

verse.textEn: Look! The wages you failed to pay the workers who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of Yahweh Almighty.
verse.textZh: 工人给你们收割庄稼，你们亏欠他们的工钱，这工钱有声音呼叫，并且那收割之人的冤声已经入了万军之主的耳了。
